chapters.title: Chapter 5087: My Pulse! II
paragraphs: He thrust one hand forward, fingers curling into the same gesture Naldine had demonstrated dozens of times.

"There was a spark when two cells came together in my mother’s womb! A moment of ignition that brought something from nothing! There was another spark when I utilized an F Rank skill book, when Mana first flooded through my existence and everything changed!"
His smile became something terrifying in its confidence.
"From MY Cause, I will focus on its fiery aspect to design my own Silurian Light! And its power...will be no lesser!"

He raised both hands toward the ceiling of their perception-space, Observable force and Infinity swirling around his form in configurations that seemed to be attempting to create something that had never existed before.
"It...will be grander!"
His laughter rang out again, triumphant and tyrannical.
"HAHA!"

The perception-space trembled violently at his declaration, that stretched moment of infinity struggling to contain the concepts he was attempting to manifest within it. Naldine rose fully from her position, her expression shifting through astonishment into something that bordered on genuine concern.
She wondered if he had truly gone mad!
At this moment, Noah felt like he was in an unprecedented trance.

Within that perception of stretched infinity, he found his consciousness fading away from the golden space where Naldine watched with growing concern. Something was pulling him inward, deeper than he’d ever gone into the foundations of his own existence. He was being drawn into a paradoxical singularity of self, a place where he was both the observer and the observed.
He felt like himself, but also as if he was watching himself from somewhere outside the boundaries of his own awareness.
His vision opened up.

He saw a woman grabbing her belly in a cramped apartment, her face twisted with the discomfort of early pregnancy. Amelia Osmont. His mother. She was young in this vision, younger than he remembered her being, with dark hair falling across features that held beauty despite the exhaustion pressing against them.

In the living room, his father was already knocked out on the couch. A few bottles of beer stretched across the coffee table and floor around him, their labels peeling and contents long emptied. The man snored with the rhythm of someone who’d made unconsciousness his preferred state of existence.
This was his Cause already in process.
The moment the waste of his father contributed what little he could to his formation, and as he underwent development in his mother’s womb, his Cause unfolded across nine months of biological fire.
|Observing: Your Cause.|
|Stage: Cellular Division and Formation.|

Cell division was fire. Each mitosis was a spark of creation, a single cell igniting into two, two into four, four into eight, multiplication cascading like flames spreading through dry kindling. The metabolic processes that sustained this growth burned nutrients into energy, oxidation reactions producing heat that maintained the precise temperature required for development.

His neural pathways formed like lightning, electrical signals sparking across developing synapses for the first time. His heart ignited with its first beat, a rhythm of combustion that would continue for decades to come. The very oxygen his mother breathed fed flames of creation within her womb, each breath stoking the fire of his emergence.
|Fiery Processes Detected: Cellular ignition. Metabolic combustion. Neural spark formation. Cardiac rhythm initialization. Oxidative development sustained across 40 weeks of gestation.|
|These processes represent the kindling of Your Cause.|

Noah closed his eyes within this vision and focused on these processes, feeling the heat of his own creation as if it were happening in real time rather than being observed across decades of separation.
Time fast-forwarded.

He found himself in a hospital room, sterile lights buzzing overhead as his mother lay alone in a bed designed for moments that should have been shared. She was giving birth while his father gambled somewhere across the city, chasing losses that would never be recovered.
The doctors and nurses moved around her with professional efficiency, but the absence of anyone who actually cared pressed against the scene like a wound that wouldn’t close.
This was also his Cause.
|Stage: Emergence.|

|The first breath is fire. Oxygen flooding lungs that have never known air, igniting systems that operated in fluid darkness for nine months. The severing of the umbilical cord is the separation of flames, a new fire burning independent of its source.|
|Body temperature regulation commences. Internal combustion sustains existence outside the womb. Your Cause continues its unfolding.|
A baby’s cry echoed through the hospital room, and Noah recognized his own voice from before he understood what voices were for.
Time moved forward again.

He grew up in fragments, years passing like pages being flipped through a book too quickly to read. Childhood. Adolescence. The mundane struggles of someone trying to survive in a world that didn’t particularly care if he succeeded or failed. His mother working multiple jobs. His father disappearing for longer and longer periods.
Then dungeons descended unto the world, and the apocalypse began.

Everything changed. Reality itself seemed to crack open, and humanity discovered it had been living in ignorance of forces that had always existed beyond their perception. Monsters emerged from nowhere. People awakened to powers they couldn’t explain. The old world burned, and from its ashes, a new world struggled to take shape.
Noah did everything to become a Hunter.

He found himself in that dilapidated apartment. The walls were cracked. The ceiling leaked when it rained. The single window looked out on an alley where garbage accumulated faster than anyone bothered to remove it.
But in his hands, he held a skill book.
[Fireball].

The cheapest offensive skill on the market, an F Rank ability that most serious Hunters wouldn’t bother picking up from the ground if they found it lying in a dungeon. But to him, in that moment, it representedEverything. It represented possibility. It represented the first step toward becoming something more than what his circumstances had decided he should be.
The skill book faded into lights that entered his body.
|Stage: First Kindling of Authority.|
|Mana integration commences. A spark of power ignites within a vessel that had known only mundane existence. This moment marks the transition from potential to actualization.|
|Your Cause continues its unfolding.|
That was also part of his Cause.

Just because these moments were mundane didn’t mean they lacked power. A normal human woman with no authority had given birth to him in a hospital room while his father threw money away on games he couldn’t win. A cheap skill book had introduced Mana to his system for the first time. None of it seemed grand by the standards of beings who measured significance in eons and Observable Existences.
But from all this, a Seed of Observable Existence had bloomed due to his hands.

That was a big thing. That was a very big thing! And in the future, he knew it would become a genuine Observable Existence, would bloom into something that rivaled or surpassed the reality he currently inhabited. His Cause would become even grander with time.
So even though it was mundane, this was significant.
An illusory consciousness of Noah gazed at his young self in that apartment room.

The contrast was stark. His younger self stood there in worn clothes, thin from meals skipped to save money. His current self floated nearby, wrapped in golden Observable force, bearing Hadean Bones and connections to Gilded Lifeforms and Infinity integrated so thoroughly into his existence that separation would be impossible.
The same person. Separated by accomplishments that his younger self couldn’t have imagined even in his most ambitious dreams.
"My Cause...has always beenTHE Infinite Cause."
His voice emerged with certainty that pressed against this vision of the past.
"From myself, from my Cause, I shall draw power from what it represents and what it has accomplished. I shall establish my own Pulse of The Scales."
BOOM!

"From myself, from my Cause, I shall draw power from what it represents and what it has accomplished.
I shall establish my own Pulse of The Scales."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5088: My Pulse! III
paragraphs: The vision shattered.
|Acknowledgment Detected.|
|You are establishing resonance with personal Cause.|
|Classification:THE Infinite Cause.|
|Origin: Mundane emergence leading to Infinite potential.|
|This Cause is recognized as valid for Pulse derivation.|

Golden light exploded through Noah’s awareness as he felt power being drawn from the very foundation of his existence. Not from THE Silurian Cause that had formed this Observable Existence. Not from any external source that he had to beg or borrow or steal from. From himself. From what he was and what he had become and what he would eventually be.
|Pulse Derivation Commencing.|
|Source: THE Infinite Cause.|
|Focus: Fiery aspect of emergence.|

|The spark of cellular division. The combustion of metabolism. The ignition of first breath. The kindling of first Mana. All fires that contributed to THE Infinite Cause are being synthesized into singular expression.|
|Pulse Classification: [Calculating].|

His body began flooding with Observable force unlike anything he’d experienced before. The connection between him and Eon, that pathway of Quintessence Infiniforce that had been steadily transmitting golden light into his existence, suddenly increased a hundredfold in bandwidth. Where a river had been flowing, now an ocean surged.
|Connection to Gilded Lifeform: Expanding.|
|Observable force transmission: Increasing by factor of 100.|
|Reason: Pulse establishment requires sufficient authority to stabilize. Gilded connection is compensating for Bounded limitations.|

The endlessly generating Quintessence Infiniforce within his body joined the flood, his own production combining with what Eon’s existence was providing. And beyond that, he felt Infinity itself responding across Observable Existence, his claims scattered throughout reality beginning to channel support toward this singular moment of establishment.
|Warning.|
|You are deviating from the set weavings of existence.|
|You are deviating from Vakochev’s Scales of Existence.|
|You are establishing a Pulse outside The Scales.|
|This action has no precedent. This action has no predicted outcome. This action may attract attention from classifications that monitor deviations of this nature.|
|Be careful.|
|Be cautious.|
|Due to your current actions and your connection to a Gilded Lifeform, your Civilizational Access and Existential Access has been modified and altered.|
|Previous Access: 0.9%.|
|Current Access: 5%.|
|You have crossed the threshold required for Pulse perception and utilization.|
|Unknown changes are beginning to occur across your existence.|
BOOM!
Immensity and heaviness began to bloom within Noah as something fundamental shifted in the foundations of what he was.
He could feel it. Depths of his Civilization that had been invisible moments before were suddenly perceivable, as if someone had turned on lights in rooms he hadn’t known existed.
And somewhere in those newly illuminated depths, he could sense something waiting.
A Pulse.
His Pulse!
The changes began immediately.
Noah felt his awareness expanding in directions he hadn’t known existed!
His Civilization stretched before him with depths that his previous 0.9% access couldn’t have perceived, couldn’t have imagined, couldn’t have touched even if he’d known they were there.
|Civilizational Access: 5%.|
|New perception thresholds unlocked.|

|You can now perceive Civilizational depths previously invisible to your awareness. Weavings that seemed impossible at sub-1% access are now merely difficult. Weavings that seemed difficult are now natural expressions of your Civilization.|
He could see it!
He could see!
"More...MORE!" he said aloud within the perception-space.
HUUM!

Naldine was watching him with expression that had shifted from concern into something approaching genuine shock. She could sense what was happening even if she couldn’t perceive the specifics, could feel the fundamental shift occurring in his foundations.
|Connection to Gilded Lifeform: Stabilizing at enhanced parameters.|
|Current bandwidth: Enhanced by factor of 100.|
|Observable force from THE Secretive Eon is flooding your existence at rates previously impossible for Bounded classification.|

The golden light flowing into him from Eon felt different now. Before, it had been like drinking from a stream, satisfying but limited by the capacity of the channel. Now it was like standing beneath a waterfall, Observable force crashing into his existence with density that should have been overwhelming but instead felt exactly right.
His body could handle it.
More than that, his body was fucking hungry for it. Oh, he wanted all of it!
|THE Hadean Organ of Civilization: Responding to increased Observable force input.|
|Processing efficiency: Increasing.|
|Previous efficiency: 847% above baseline Proterozoic parameters.|
|Current efficiency:8,470% above baseline Proterozoic parameters.|
|THE Hadean Organ is evolving in response to new conditions. Changes are ongoing.|

The Hadean Organ was a grand thing, the construct that made his recent impossible progression possible. Now it was growing stronger alongside everything else, adapting to the flood of Observable force rather than being overwhelmed by it!
He turned his attention to his Hadean Bones.

THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp blazed brighter than before, those transformed carpals and metacarpals and phalanges radiating light that pressed against the perception-space itself. The transformation spreading up his arm had accelerated, golden brilliance consuming his radius and ulna with speed that would have taken hours under previous conditions.
His othet hand had began to shine, and his legs were starting to shine too!
|Hadean Bone transformation: Accelerating.|
|At current rate, full skeletal transformation will complete in approximately 37 hours of active cultivation.|

He could feel the bones in his extremities burning with pleasant heat as Observable force saturated them, as Hadean transformation consumed what had been mundane structure and replaced it with something that existed above THE Proterozoic Scale entirely.
|Hadean classification remains unknown and unprecedented.|
|System cannot accurately predict outcomes of full Hadean skeletal transformation.|
|Proceeding with caution is advised.|
|You...are not proceeding with caution.|
|Okay.|
Noah almost laughed at that last line. Caution? Fuck caution!
|Changes detected across all connected existences.|
|THE Infiniverse: Responding to increased Civilizational Access.|
|Ozymandias: Responding to increased Observable force transmission.|
|Secondary bodies: Responding to expanded perception thresholds.|
|All aspects of your existence are being affected by this transition.|

THE Infiniverse and its Three Thousand Realms was pulsing with new energy. The connection between it and his primary existence had always been strong, but now it felt like the boundary between them was thinning, like the distinction between Noah and THE Infiniverse was becoming less meaningful.
|THE Infiniverse: Civilizational resonance increasing.|
|Your Seed of Observable Existence is responding to the recognition of THE Infinite Cause.|
|Growth rate: Accelerating.|
|The Seed recognizes that its origin has been acknowledged as a valid Cause. This recognition is feeding back into the Seed itself, strengthening its foundations.|

His Cause was connected to everything he’d accomplished, and the Seed was one of his greatest accomplishments. By acknowledging THE Infinite Cause, he was also acknowledging everything that Cause had produced, and that acknowledgment carried power.
That...was not too confusing, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 5089: My Pulse! IV
paragraphs: Ozymandias, still frozen in that instant of objective time outside this perception-space, was changing too.
|Ozymandias: Enhanced Observable force transmission detected.|
|THE Hadean Desmoterion: Receiving increased input.|
|Civilizational Eons of Development within THE Hadean Desmoterion: Accelerating.|
|New capabilities detected at 5% Civilizational Access.|
|Category 1: Existential Anchoring.|

|You can now perceive how Civilizational Anchors interface with Observable and Unobservable forces at fundamental levels. This perception may allow for manipulation of anchoring processes in self and others. You can declare and establish your Civilizational Anchor at anytime. Your entry into the second scale officially, is whenever you feel like it.|
|Category 2: Causal Threading.|

|You can now perceive the threads connecting actions to consequences across time. This perception is prerequisite for Pulse utilization. Without it, THE Silurian Light and similar capabilities would remain invisible regardless of power level.|
|Category 3: Scale Interfacing.|
|You can now perceive how THE First Scale and THE Second Scale interact at boundary conditions. This perception may allow for capabilities that blur the distinction between Scales.|
|Category 4: Designation Boundaries.|
|You can now perceive a bit more of the engineering that distinguishes Bounded and Gilded classifications. The study into Eon will soon yield some results.|
|Category 5: Cause Recognition.|

|You can now perceive the Causes underlying the usage of power other existences, not merely your own. This perception may allow for Pulse derivation from external sources if sufficient resonance is established.|
Noah absorbed each category with growing appreciation for what five percent access actually meant. These were fundamental shifts in what he could perceive and therefore what he could eventually do.

Cause Recognition was unique. If he could perceive the Causes underlying other existences, could he eventually derive Pulses from Causes that weren’t his own? Could he touch THE Silurian Cause itself and pull traditional Silurian Light alongside his own Infinite variant?

But speaking of his own Cause, he could feel something else happening. Something in those newly illuminated depths of his Civilization, something that had been waiting for him to achieve sufficient access to perceive it.
|Pulse Formation: In Progress.|
|Your Cause has been acknowledged. Your fiery aspect has been identified. Your derivation is stabilizing.|
|Pulse Classification: THE Infinite Light.|
|Status: Nascent.|
|Detailed analysis cannot yet be given.|
THE Infinite Light.
His Pulse had a name now!
It existed within his Civilization as something he could utilizs, a thread of fire connecting to THE Infinite Cause he’d acknowledged as his origin.
|Final Status Update.|
|Civilizational Access: 5% (stable) / Existential Access: 5% (stable).|
|Connection to Gilded Lifeform: Enhanced (ongoing).|
|Hadean transformation: Accelerating.|

|Overall assessment: You have fundamentally altered your existence in ways that cannot be reversed. The path forward is unknown. The outcomes are unpredictable. You have deviated from every established methodology and created a trajectory that has no precedent. No abnormalities have been observed as a response from THE Vakochev Scales similar to when you first stepped into them.|
Noah’s eyes fully opened back in that stretched out moment of infinity.

His gaze came to land on Naldine, and uniquely, he found this powerful being actually take a step back from his gaze alone. His power shouldn’t have changed drastically in this moment of stretched perception. These were only their perceptions here, after all. Nothing physical had transformed yet.
But he had changed in how he perceived himself.

Now he was a man who had a Cause. He’d always had this Cause, had carried it since the moment two cells sparked together in his mother’s womb, but he’d never affirmed it. Never known about it. Never possessed the unique knowledge required to truly apply the immensity of what his existence represented.
He couldn’t help but smile as he looked toward this Primordial Architect.
"Do I scare you now, Naldine Manthon?"

At such words, Naldine’s eyes flashed sharply. Her singularity-dotted gaze held his without flinching despite the step she’d taken backward, and when she spoke, her voice emerged calm and gloriously measured.
"Fear is not something that will ever settle in my heart."
She paused, studying him with intensity that pressed against his awareness.
"But in your eyes... how could it possibly have such a light? A light of someone who has seen something unfathomably grand. A light that very few can ever express even within THE Wyld."
Her voice softened slightly.
"A light of those who have witnessed a grand Cause."

Noah felt all the changes that would unfold as soon as he left this moment of stretched perception. The Observable force flooding in from Eon. The accelerating Hadean transformation. The nascent Pulse waiting to be channeled. All of it held in suspension, ready to crash into reality the instant he released this infinity.
He smiled and said, "I told you. My emergence is a Cause as grand as THE First Cause."
His golden eyes blazed brighter.
"You can consider this a claim that only I make. You can consider it mad. But I make such a claim boldly."
He looked toward the frozen landscape beyond their perception-space, toward Grimvault’s suspended smile and the motionless wings of swords and the serpentine coils held in stillness.
"And now, I’m ready to end this stretched moment of perception."
His gaze returned to her.
"Are you?"

She looked at him for a few seconds, those pure white eyes with their floating blue singularities assessing him with judgment that spanned eons of accumulated wisdom. Whatever she saw in his expression, whatever she perceived in that light he now carried, it was enough!
Oh, it had to be enough!
She nodded.
Noah smiled as he clenched his hand into a fist.
BOOM!

The infinity around him began to shatter, that stretched moment cracking like glass as their perceptions were returned to normal time. He would effectively resume the battle against a terrifying Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity, against Grimvault who possessed THE Silurian Light and capabilities that should have been impossible to counter.
But who he was a moment before and who he would be a moment later were quintessentially different.
Who he would be was so different!

chapters.title: Chapter 5090: Nothing Could Repay!
paragraphs: The waters of THE Infiniverse held depths that Amelia Osmont was still learning to navigate.
She floated within a serene pocket of the transformed reality her son had created, surrounded by currents of crimson and blue and gold that moved with purpose she couldn’t quite comprehend.
The ancient pink dolphin floating before her was one of many wonders she’d been interested in.
THE Mnemonic Leviathan regarded her with eyes that held eons of accumulated wisdom, its form radiating gentle authority. She’d grown comfortable speaking with this being!

"So," Amelia said, her voice carrying the practical skepticism she’d never quite abandoned, "that you and THE Baboon of Wisdom both came from the same... what did you call it? Singular Cognizance? Does that make you a Singular Cognizance too?"
THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s form shimmered with amusement.

"THE Beholder is the Singular Cognizance from which my existence and that of THE Baboon of Wisdom originated. We are, in a sense, fragments of a greater whole that chose to express itself through multiple forms, though I am not truly a Singular Cognizance..."
Amelia nodded slowly.
"With the permission of your son, THE Beholder is making their way to THE Infiniverse as we speak. They will be here shortly."
Amelia blinked, but before she could reply, everything changed.
HUUM!
Waves of blue Infinity erupted from her existence without warning!

The energy cascaded outward from her form in configurations she couldn’t control, couldn’t understand, couldn’t do anything but witness as it happened. And alongside that blue brilliance, golden waves of Observable force began pouring into her from somewhere beyond her perception, flooding her existence with density that should have been overwhelming.
"What-"
She couldn’t finish the word.

THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s ancient pink form recoiled in astonishment, those wise eyes widening as it witnessed something it clearly hadn’t anticipated. The waters around them churned with the force of what was occurring, currents that had been serene moments before now turbulent with energies that pressed against the boundaries of this pocket of this Realm!
Amelia was shocked at the waves of force pouring into her, at the blue light bleeding from her skin, at the sensation of something fundamental shifting in what she was!
Before her eyes, radiant blue prompts began to appear.
|You have been affirmed as an Originator of an Unfathomable Cause.|
|Cause Classification: THE Infinite Cause.|
|Your Role: Primary Vessel of Emergence.|
The words hung in her vision!
|THE Infinite Cause has been acknowledged by its product. In acknowledging his Cause, he has acknowledged you.|
|You carried him for nine months while working double shifts to pay rent your husband gambled away. You felt him kick for the first time while standing exhausted, and you smiled anyway.|

|You gave birth to him alone in a hospital room because the man who should have been there chose cards over his own son’s first breath. You held that baby boy and promised him the world even though you had nothing to give.|

|You took care of him on countless restless nights when fever burned through his small body and you couldn’t afford medicine, so you held him and prayed and stayed awake until morning because that was all you could do.|
|When he was lost, you found him. When he was scared, you held him. When he doubted himself, you reminded him of who he was.|

|You taught him strength by being strong when you had every reason to break. You taught him persistence by refusing to give up when the world gave you nothing but reasons to quit. You taught him love by loving him unconditionally even when love was the only thing you had left to give.|
|Nothing could repay the endless nights. Nothing could possibly repay the hard work and sacrifice of a mother who chose her son over herself a thousand times without hesitation.|
|But this is a start.|
Amelia’s vision blurred as tears began forming in her eyes.
The prompts continued!
|Distinction Granted:Originator of THE Infinite Cause.|

|You are recognized as the vessel through which an Unfathomable Cause emerged into existence. This distinction cannot be taken, cannot be diminished, cannot be denied by any authority in Observable or Unobservable existence.|
|Boons of the Originator:|
|Existential Immunity: No force derived from THE Infinite Cause can harm you. Your son’s power, in all its forms, will always recognize you as its origin and protect you accordingly.|
|Causal Resonance: You will passively benefit from all advancements THE Infinite Cause achieves. As your son grows stronger, echoes of that strength will flow to you.|

|Observable Blessing: The connection your son has established with Gilded classification now extends a thread to your existence. You will receive a fraction of the Observable force flooding into him, enough to elevate you beyond all limitations.|
|Infinite Affection: THE Infinite Cause remembers. Every sacrifice, every sleepless night, every tear shed in private so your son wouldn’t see you struggling. It remembers, and it will never forget.|
Amelia Osmont became teary-eyed as she was reminded of years past.
She saw flashes of memory in those prompts, moments she’d thought forgotten now illuminated with significance she’d never attributed to them!
The time she’d skipped meals for a week so Noah could have new shoes for school. She knew others would make fun of him wearing extremely worn down shoes!
The night she’d held him through a thunderstorm because he was afraid and she’d told him she’d always protect him.
All of it mattered.
All of it had contributed to what he’d become!
And now, impossibly, some of what he’d become was flowing back to her.

While such a phenomenon unfolded around Amelia Osmont, while blue Infinity and golden Observable force continued flooding into her existence in ways that defied everything THE Mnemonic Leviathan understood about how power worked, a new presence made itself known.
"What... is this?"
An ancient voice boomed out with marvel that pressed against the entirety of this Realm.

It was a voice that made THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s authority seem small by comparison, a voice that carried weight accumulated across spans that predated most current existences. It was the voice of THE Beholder, the Progenitor of THE Baboon of Wisdom and THE Mnemonic Leviathan, the Singular Cognizance who had been granted entry into THE Infiniverse.
And that ancient being had arrived just in time to witness something unprecedented.
A mother receiving acknowledgment from her son’s Cause!
BOOM!
The infinity shattered.

Noah’s perception slammed back into normal time with force that should have been disorienting, but he’d spent subjective days preparing for this exact moment. Everything that had been frozen resumed its motion simultaneously. Grimvault’s smile completed its brutal curve. The multicolored rain began falling again. Beowulf’s screams filled the air with renewed agony.
And Noah’s body erupted with golden light.
HUUM!

Observable force radiated from his existence in waves that pressed against everything within range, density unlike anything he’d produced before flooding outward from foundations that had fundamentally changed during those stretched days of infinity. The connection to Eon blazed a hundredfold brighter than it had been, golden rivers crashing into his existence with intensity that painted the destroyed battlefield in hues of impossible brilliance.
Both Noah and Ozymandias moved in perfect synchrony.

Their bodies shifted simultaneously, the titanic frame of Ozymandias and the comparatively small form of Noah turning toward Grimvault with unified intent that declared their shared purpose. The changes from THE Infinite Cause were already beginning to bloom through their connected existence, transformation accelerating in ways that objective time had never witnessed before.
Noah’s voice emerged from both mouths at once.
"Grimvault."
The word boomed across the battlefield from two sources simultaneously, his primary body and Ozymandias speaking as one entity despite their separate forms.
"Let me see what Calymmian is all about!"
BOOM!
Both bodies surged toward the most powerful entity on the enemy side.
The discrepancy in power was absurd. Grimvault stood at the Calymmian Tier with ninety-four percent Proterozoic Bone saturation and four Proterozoic Organs.
Noah was technically still at THE First Scale, and even Ozymandias at Rhyacian couldn’t match that density of transformed existence. Charging directly at such a being should have been suicide.
Noah didn’t care.

Naldine sighed behind him as she watched his charge begin. She knew she couldn’t change his mind, knew that arguing would accomplish nothing against someone who had just acknowledged his own birth as a Cause equal to those that formed Observable Existences. This crazy fucker.
He had to for sure be mad from Infinity already!
Her fingers found the strings of her Vihuela as she turned her gaze coldly toward...Vahrkosis.
"I suppose we each have our roles to play,"she murmured.

THE Primordial Paradox stretched his obsidian titanic form beside where Noah had been standing, joints crackling with authority that pressed against the destroyed battlefield. He turned his attention toward Sammarthiel, toward those six wings of burning and frozen swords, toward the being who claimed Paradox as his Civilization just as Erwin did.
"The Paradox Bearer," he said with voice that held amusement beneath its ancient weight. "Let us see whose contradictions run deeper."
The battle divided into three parts!

sentences.text: The waters of THE Infiniverse held depths that Amelia Osmont was still learning to navigate.
She floated within a serene pocket of the transformed reality her son had created, surrounded by currents of crimson and blue and gold that moved with purpose she couldn’t quite comprehend.
The ancient pink dolphin floating before her was one of many wonders she’d been interested in.
THE Mnemonic Leviathan regarded her with eyes that held eons of accumulated wisdom, its form radiating gentle authority.
She’d grown comfortable speaking with this being!
"So," Amelia said, her voice carrying the practical skepticism she’d never quite abandoned, "that you and THE Baboon of Wisdom both came from the same... what did you call it?
Singular Cognizance?
Does that make you a Singular Cognizance too?"
THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s form shimmered with amusement.
"THE Beholder is the Singular Cognizance from which my existence and that of THE Baboon of Wisdom originated.
We are, in a sense, fragments of a greater whole that chose to express itself through multiple forms, though I am not truly a Singular Cognizance..."
Amelia nodded slowly.
"With the permission of your son, THE Beholder is making their way to THE Infiniverse as we speak.
They will be here shortly."
Amelia blinked, but before she could reply, everything changed.
HUUM!
Waves of blue Infinity erupted from her existence without warning!
The energy cascaded outward from her form in configurations she couldn’t control, couldn’t understand, couldn’t do anything but witness as it happened.

And alongside that blue brilliance, golden waves of Observable force began pouring into her from somewhere beyond her perception, flooding her existence with density that should have been overwhelming.
"What-"
She couldn’t finish the word.
THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s ancient pink form recoiled in astonishment, those wise eyes widening as it witnessed something it clearly hadn’t anticipated.

The waters around them churned with the force of what was occurring, currents that had been serene moments before now turbulent with energies that pressed against the boundaries of this pocket of this Realm!
Amelia was shocked at the waves of force pouring into her, at the blue light bleeding from her skin, at the sensation of something fundamental shifting in what she was!
Before her eyes, radiant blue prompts began to appear.
|You have been affirmed as an Originator of an Unfathomable Cause.|
|Cause Classification: THE Infinite Cause.|
|Your Role: Primary Vessel of Emergence.|
The words hung in her vision!
|THE Infinite Cause has been acknowledged by its product.
In acknowledging his Cause, he has acknowledged you.|
|You carried him for nine months while working double shifts to pay rent your husband gambled away.
You felt him kick for the first time while standing exhausted, and you smiled anyway.|
|You gave birth to him alone in a hospital room because the man who should have been there chose cards over his own son’s first breath.
You held that baby boy and promised him the world even though you had nothing to give.|

|You took care of him on countless restless nights when fever burned through his small body and you couldn’t afford medicine, so you held him and prayed and stayed awake until morning because that was all you could do.|
|When he was lost, you found him.
When he was scared, you held him.
When he doubted himself, you reminded him of who he was.|
|You taught him strength by being strong when you had every reason to break.
You taught him persistence by refusing to give up when the world gave you nothing but reasons to quit.
You taught him love by loving him unconditionally even when love was the only thing you had left to give.|
|Nothing could repay the endless nights.
Nothing could possibly repay the hard work and sacrifice of a mother who chose her son over herself a thousand times without hesitation.|
|But this is a start.|
Amelia’s vision blurred as tears began forming in her eyes.
The prompts continued!
|Distinction Granted:Originator of THE Infinite Cause.|
|You are recognized as the vessel through which an Unfathomable Cause emerged into existence.
This distinction cannot be taken, cannot be diminished, cannot be denied by any authority in Observable or Unobservable existence.|
|Boons of the Originator:|
|Existential Immunity: No force derived from THE Infinite Cause can harm you.
Your son’s power, in all its forms, will always recognize you as its origin and protect you accordingly.|
|Causal Resonance: You will passively benefit from all advancements THE Infinite Cause achieves.
As your son grows stronger, echoes of that strength will flow to you.|
|Observable Blessing: The connection your son has established with Gilded classification now extends a thread to your existence.
You will receive a fraction of the Observable force flooding into him, enough to elevate you beyond all limitations.|
|Infinite Affection: THE Infinite Cause remembers.
Every sacrifice, every sleepless night, every tear shed in private so your son wouldn’t see you struggling.
It remembers, and it will never forget.|
Amelia Osmont became teary-eyed as she was reminded of years past.
She saw flashes of memory in those prompts, moments she’d thought forgotten now illuminated with significance she’d never attributed to them!
The time she’d skipped meals for a week so Noah could have new shoes for school.
She knew others would make fun of him wearing extremely worn down shoes!
The night she’d held him through a thunderstorm because he was afraid and she’d told him she’d always protect him.
All of it mattered.
All of it had contributed to what he’d become!
And now, impossibly, some of what he’d become was flowing back to her.

While such a phenomenon unfolded around Amelia Osmont, while blue Infinity and golden Observable force continued flooding into her existence in ways that defied everything THE Mnemonic Leviathan understood about how power worked, a new presence made itself known.

chapters.title: Chapter 5091: Evolution I
paragraphs: Noah and Ozymandias reached Grimvault in the span of a heartbeat, both bodies closing the distance with speed. The wolf-helmed Primordial Architect observed their approach with those pale fires burning in his empty eye sockets, and he raised his Axiom greatsword with a casual motion that suggested he found their charge more entertaining than threatening.

"I will beat you to paste first,"Grimvault declared, his deep voice pressing against reality itself, "and collect what remains of your weavings to bring to THE Wyld. There, they will study what made you so interesting before your existence ends."
His greatsword descended with a terrifying force that warped the space around its trajectory.
"Here is my pure Civilization. Just feel it!"
BOOM!
The impact was devastating.

Noah’s transformed right hand, THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp, caught the flat of that descending blade alongside Ozymandias’s matching grip. Seas of blue Infinity converged on their palms as they met the weapon of a Calymmian Tier entity, that impossible force pressing against hands that should have been obliterated by mere proximity to such power.

Quintessence Infiniforce blazed from both bodies in configurations of multiple colors, the endless generation of his unique force type flooding outward in response to the strain being placed upon his existence!
Golden Observable force surged within Noah’s foundations as Eon’s connection provided density that his Bounded classification couldn’t naturally produce.
And then the impact truly registered.

Both Noah and Ozymandias buzzed with sensation that transcended pain, their connected existence vibrating at frequencies that existence wasn’t designed to accommodate. In that instant, it felt like every bone in their bodies was about to break. Every single one. Not cracking or fracturing but shattering entirely, reduced to powder beneath force that Calymmian entities wielded as casually as normal beings might swing a stick.
Noah felt every cell preparing to rupture as the pain was unfathomable!
Pain! Pain!PAIN!

His skin wanted to tear. His muscles wanted to liquefy. His organs wanted to burst apart into configurations that could no longer be called organs. The force Grimvault had delivered through that single swing was enough to extinguish First Scale entities by the thousands, and he’d taken it directly into his hands.
But Observable force surged.

Golden light flooded into every cell that was breaking, into every structure that was failing, into every component of his existence that Grimvault’s attack was destroying. The concentration was terrifying, density exceeding anything he’d experienced before as Eon’s enhanced connection provided resources that his Bounded classification could never have generated independently.
The cells regenerated instantly.

New cells replaced destroyed ones before destruction could complete. His bones were breaking and reforming simultaneously, his organs were rupturing and rebuilding in the same instant, his entire existence was undergoing cycles of annihilation and rebirth compressed into spans so short that objective time couldn’t properly measure them.

He paradoxically underwent simultaneous destruction and rebirth of all cells while also not undergoing either, both states existing in the same moment through depths of his Civilization he could now perceive at five percent access. THE First Tongue was the language of Existence itself, and at five percent, he could speak words of self-definition that rewrote what was happening to his body even as it happened.
And when that paradox resolved, every cell in his body wasblindingly new.
Grander than what had existed before.
All bones within his body began to shine simultaneously.
|Miniature Cause Triggered.|
|Classification:THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth.|
|Nature: Internal evolutionary acceleration.|

|Unlike something like THE Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity which produces external phenomena across Observable Existence, this Cause operates strictly within your existence. External force of sufficient magnitude triggers accelerated transformation. The greater the force received, the more comprehensive the evolution.|
|Initial Catalyst: Impact from Calymmian Tier Proterozoic Scale entity.|
|Result: Force sufficient to extinguish your existence has instead catalyzed universal Hadean transformation.|
|All bones within your existence are now being saturated with Observable force and Quintessence Infiniforce at concentrations exceeding previous parameters.|
|Current Progress: All Bones toward Hadean Classification: 3%.|
Oh!
Noah and Ozymandias both roared.
BOOM!

They rebuffed the immense strike, pushing Grimvault’s Axiom greatsword away from their shining palms with force that shouldn’t have been possible from beings at their classification. The wolf-helmed Primordial Architect didn’t stumble, didn’t even shift his stance, but those pale fires in his empty eye sockets flickered with something that might have been surprise.
Then he smiled.
That wolf skull helm somehow conveyed amusement despite possessing no features capable of expression, and when he spoke, his deep voice held genuine entertainment.
"Interesting."
He lowered his greatsword slightly, observing the golden light radiating from Noah’s existence.

"It seems you really are something unique in Observable Existence. How can you survive the pure force of Calymmian? For a second there, I thought I felt like I destroyed everything of your small body."
His smile widened beneath that helm.
"Come, take another strike! A true strike!"
BOOM!

Grimvault swung his Axiom weapon again, and this time it shone with light that seemed to contain depths beyond what the previous attack had carried. The greatsword blazed with authority that declared its nature to anyone capable of perceiving it, the complete Axiom that Noah had detected during his initial analysis now revealing capabilities that simple observation couldn’t have predicted.
Noah and Ozymandias raised their shining hands to meet the blow.
As if Grimvault was a hammer and they were weapons being forged, they would use his attacks to refine themselves.
BOOM!

The impact landed with force exceeding the previous strike, and Noah once more felt every cell within his body nearly extinguish, or really, paradoxically fully extinguish and not extinguish. Golden light of Observable force actually formed into liquid seas around his existence as he sought to resist power grander than before.
But something was different this time.

The Axiom Grimvault carried held a devastating light that seemed to bring cycles upon cycles of destruction, attacks replicating within the span of the initial impact in configurations that normal weapons couldn’t produce.
|Axiom Identified: THE Octogenary Echo.|
|Classification: Complete Axiom of Multiplicative Force.|
|Capability: Any force exerted through this weapon is replicated 81 times within the span of 1 nanosecond following initial contact.|
|Current Status: Replication sequence initiating.|
|You will experience the full force of Grimvault’s strike 81 times in the next nanosecond.|
|Brace yourself.|
The blows came.
One. Two. Three!

Each impact carried the same devastating force as the initial strike, the same power that had nearly extinguished Noah’s entire existence compressed into spans so short that normal perception couldn’t register them as separate events. His bones screamed with stress that should have shattered them into dust. His organs wailed with strain that should have liquefied them entirely.
Four. Five. Six. Seven!

Observable force flooded in with each cycle of destruction, golden light rebuilding what the previous impact had broken before the next impact could find weakness in damaged structures. Quintessence Infiniforce generated endlessly within his foundations, providing resources that the transformation required regardless of how quickly those resources were being consumed.
Eight. Nine. Ten. Eleven. Twelve!

Noah’s expression shone with glory as he felt his bones and existence taking in the force once, twice, three times, twelve times, twenty times. Each individual attack was capable of destroying him. Each blow carried sufficient power to end his existence permanently. And yet the endless generation of Observable force and Quintessence Infiniforce rebuilt him stronger with every cycle.
Thirty. Thirty-one. Thirty-two!
This terrifying capability of an Axiom that should have been deadly was actually accelerating his growth! Oh!
Every booming cycle of destruction bathed every atom within him with Observable force and Quintessence Infiniforce!
Fifty. Fifty-one. Fifty-two!

Everything about the old him was being washed away. Every cell that had existed before this battle was being replaced with something new, something grander, something saturated with forces that his previous existence couldn’t have contained.
Seventy. Seventy-one. Seventy-two!

This new him was being forged with every impact, filled to the brim with more Infiniforce and Observable Force than he’d ever possessed, density increasing with each cycle of the Octogenary Echo’s devastating replication.
Eighty.Eighty-one.
|THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth: Comprehensive Evolution Triggered.|
|The Miniature Cause within you has expanded its scope.|

|All organs and components of your existence are now included in the transformation toward Hadean classification. Every aspect of your being is being filled with increasingly dense concentrations of Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force.|
|Hadean Transformation Progress Report:|
|Skeletal Structure:|
|Right Hand (THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp): 100% Complete.|
|Right Arm (Radius, Ulna, Humerus): 67% Complete.|
|Left Hand: 34% Complete.|
|Left Arm: 19% Complete.|
|Right Leg (Femur, Patella, Tibia, Fibula, Tarsals, Metatarsals, Phalanges): 28% Complete.|
|Left Leg: 24% Complete.|
|Spine (Cervical, Thoracic, Lumbar, Sacral, Coccygeal Vertebrae): 15% Complete.|
|Ribcage (12 pairs of ribs, Sternum): 12% Complete.|
|Skull (Cranium, Facial Bones): 8% Complete.|
|Pelvis (Ilium, Ischium, Pubis): 11% Complete.|
|Organ Systems:|
|Heart: 4% Hadean Saturation.|
|Lungs: 3% Hadean Saturation.|
|Brain: 6% Hadean Saturation (benefiting from connection to Ozymandias’s THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation).|
|Liver: 2% Hadean Saturation.|
|Kidneys: 2% Hadean Saturation.|
|Overall Hadean Transformation: 17%.|
|Rate of transformation is dependent on external force received. Current catalyst: Calymmian Tier attacks through THE Octogenary Echo.|
|At current rate of combat intensity, full Hadean transformation may complete within this battle.|
The prompts rained down through Noah’s awareness as time seemed to slow around him.
He felt every painful impact and very rebirth. And man, it was painful!

In his perception, multicolored and golden waves of light emerged in repetitive sequence with him at the center, explosions of brilliance cascading outward as Grimvault’s Axiom delivered force that would have ended lesser existences eighty-one times over.
After every burst of light, his existence felt unfathomably grander.
More than thirty hours to fully forge his Hadean Bones?
Fuck that number completely.

If Grimvault was formidable enough, he might have all Hadean Bones within this single battle. If the Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect kept swinging that devastating Axiom, kept delivering force sufficient to trigger THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth over and over, he might achieve transformation that should have required hours in the span of minutes.
Oh!
This was Adversity!
Adversity was oh so sweet!
He wasn’t a masochist who liked being beaten. Really.

He didn’t enjoy pain for its own sake, didn’t seek suffering because suffering felt good. But as of this moment, feeling his existence shatter and rebuild stronger with every impact, watching his bones transform toward Hadean classification through force that should have killed him, he was a big fan of adversity.
Bring more of it on!
Bring someone else like Grimvault! Bring another Calymmian Proterozoic Scale being if possible! Bring someone at even higher tiers, at classifications that most couldn’t imagine!
Bring it all!
"OOOH!"

Every atom within him seethed with immensity and roared with voices that transcended physical sound. Golden seas erupted from his existence and shone across the destroyed battlefield, Observable force radiating outward in waves that painted reality itself in hues of transformation and glory.
Grimvault observed this display with those pale fires burning brighter in his empty eye sockets.
His smile hadn’t faded.
If anything, it had grown wider.

Every aspect of your being is being filled with increasingly dense concentrations of Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force.|

|Right Hand (THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp): 100% Complete.|

|Left Hand: 34% Complete.|

|Left Leg: 24% Complete.|
|Spine (Cervical, Thoracic, Lumbar, Sacral, Coccygeal Vertebrae): 15% Complete.|
|Ribcage (12 pairs of ribs, Sternum): 12% Complete.|
|Skull (Cranium, Facial Bones): 8% Complete.|
|Pelvis (Ilium, Ischium, Pubis): 11% Complete.|
|Organ Systems:|
|Heart: 4% Hadean Saturation.|
|Lungs: 3% Hadean Saturation.|
|Brain: 6% Hadean Saturation (benefiting from connection to Ozymandias’s THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation).|

Current catalyst: Calymmian Tier attacks through THE Octogenary Echo.|
|At current rate of combat intensity, full Hadean transformation may complete within this battle.|
The prompts rained down through Noah’s awareness as time seemed to slow around him.
He felt every painful impact and very rebirth.
And man, it was painful!

In his perception, multicolored and golden waves of light emerged in repetitive sequence with him at the center, explosions of brilliance cascading outward as Grimvault’s Axiom delivered force that would have ended lesser existences eighty-one times over.
After every burst of light, his existence felt unfathomably grander.
More than thirty hours to fully forge his Hadean Bones?
Fuck that number completely.
If Grimvault was formidable enough, he might have all Hadean Bones within this single battle.

If the Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect kept swinging that devastating Axiom, kept delivering force sufficient to trigger THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth over and over, he might achieve transformation that should have required hours in the span of minutes.
Oh!
This was Adversity!
Adversity was oh so sweet!
He wasn’t a masochist who liked being beaten.
Really.
He didn’t enjoy pain for its own sake, didn’t seek suffering because suffering felt good.

But as of this moment, feeling his existence shatter and rebuild stronger with every impact, watching his bones transform toward Hadean classification through force that should have killed him, he was a big fan of adversity.
Bring more of it on!
Bring someone else like Grimvault!
Bring another Calymmian Proterozoic Scale being if possible!
Bring someone at even higher tiers, at classifications that most couldn’t imagine!
Bring it all!
"OOOH!"
Every atom within him seethed with immensity and roared with voices that transcended physical sound.
Golden seas erupted from his existence and shone across the destroyed battlefield, Observable force radiating outward in waves that painted reality itself in hues of transformation and glory.
Grimvault observed this display with those pale fires burning brighter in his empty eye sockets.
His smile hadn’t faded.
If anything, it had grown wider.

chapters.title: Chapter 5092: Evolution II
paragraphs: A lot of Existences mention the glory before battle and silence after it. The glory belongs to those who survive long enough to claim it. The silence belongs to those who learned the truth.

The truth that darkness does not care about strength or conviction or righteousness. It comes for all equally, and when it arrives, every being discovers the same terrible knowledge: they were never prepared for the cold or for the absence.

Not for the regret that blooms in the space where hope used to reside. The casualties of war are the final thoughts of beings who finally understood they should have chosen differently, and understood it exactly one moment too late.
-Reflections on War.
Naldine observed the impossible.

Her fingers rested on the strings of her Vihuela as she watched Noah and Ozymandias meet Grimvault’s second strike head-on, golden light exploding outward from the impact. She could perceive what was happening to his existence even from this distance, could sense the cycles of destruction and rebirth cascading through his foundations with each blow the Calymmian entity delivered.
He was growing stronger explosively with every impact that should have killed him!
And he...hadn’t even used the Pulse he theorized yet.
What manner of existence was he?

She’d lived for eons among Primordial Architects, had witnessed beings at classifications that most couldn’t imagine, had herself achieved advancement that placed her among the distinguished of THE Wyld. But she’d never seen anything like what he was doing right now...
"THE WHORISH NALDINE!"
BOOM!
The roar shattered her contemplation.

Vahrkosis surged toward her with those forty-seven arms raised, each one wielding distinct pieces of an Axiom that blazed with entropic authority. His serpentine coils undulated through the air with speed that belied his massive form, and his voice emerged with fury.

"Focus on our grand battle! Do you think yourself so far above me that you can divide your attention? I am THE Primordial Dirge! I have consumed civilizations while you were still learning to pluck strings!"
His face, that shifting mass of features at the apex of his coils, settled into configuration of rage that seemed almost personal.

"Or perhaps you wish to watch that little bundle of Infinity die? Perhaps you’ve grown attached during whatever time you spent together? THE WHORISH NALDINE, pining after something that should not exist!"
Those words landed heavily.

Naldine’s singularity-dotted eyes turned from Noah’s battle with coldness that could have frozen stars. Her fingers, which had been resting gently on her Vihuela’s strings, pressed down with precision. Her expression, which had held analytical interest moments before, became something that made even Vahrkosis pause his charge despite his rage.
She plucked a single string.
HUUM!

The note that emerged was authority given audible form, a frequency that pressed against existence itself with command. The note washed over Vahrkosis and his serpentine coils froze mid-undulation, those forty-seven arms suspended in positions!
He was held through something he couldn’t perceive or resist!
His form remained locked in place as Naldine rose from her position, her Vihuela’s strings still resonating with frequencies that kept him immobilized while she prepared what came next.

"You hear words others have spoken and choose to use them as well? You call me whorish,"she said, her voice emerging cold and measured despite the fury burning beneath her expression. "You, who have consumed and destroyed and violated across eons of existence, dare to speak of me with such words?"
Her left hand, the one that had been her arm before she transformed it into her instrument, began to move.

Her fingers moved through the air as if writing upon reality itself, tracing symbols that existed in no language most beings could perceive. Each motion left trails of blue gold light that hung suspended, configurations that suggested letters being formed.

Her index finger drew a vertical line downward. Her middle finger curved around it in spiral that suggested revision. Her ring finger slashed horizontally through what had been written, not erasing but transforming. Her smallest finger added new strokes that changed the meaning of the entire inscription.
She was writing.
She was rewriting!
And when the somatic component completed, her voice emerged with verbal utterance that pressed against the foundations of reality itself.
"Cambrian Scribe, First of Words."
The light around her fingers blazed brighter.
"I speak the Thread. I rewrite the Thread."
The inscribed symbols began to pulse with authority that exceeded what even Proterozoic Scale entities could typically produce.
"What was shall mean another. What ended shall end differently."
Her singularity-dotted eyes locked onto Vahrkosis’s frozen form with intensity that seemed to perceive not just what he was, but what he had been and what he could become.
"THE CAMBRIAN WORD."
BOOM!
The Pulse manifested.

It was not fire like THE Silurian Light. It was not erasure or unwinding or destruction of causality. It was transformation of meaning itself, the fundamental restructuring of what consequences attached to what actions. Blue gold light erupted from Naldine’s inscribed symbols and washed over Vahrkosis with force that passed through his defenses as if they didn’t exist.
Because they didn’t exist against this.

Pulses operated on levels that normal authority couldn’t touch. They drew power from Causes themselves, from the originating forces that had formed Observable Existences, and no amount of Proterozoic Bones or Organs could provide resistance against something so fundamental.
Vahrkosis felt it immediately.

His serpentine coils began to unravel conceptually, the very meaning of his existence being rewritten by authority that exceeded his capacity to resist. The forty-seven arms that had wielded pieces of an Axiom began dissolving not into nothing but into something else, their purpose being changed from violence to dissolution, their function being rewritten from attack to self-destruction.
"What... what is this?"
His voice emerged with horror that pressed against the destroyed battlefield.
"Stop...stop!!!"

He could feel it. Every action he had ever taken was being rewritten not in occurrence but in consequence. The civilizations he had consumed were still consumed, but the strength he had gained from them was being redirected, transformed, changed from fuel for his power into fuel for his dissolution. The Proterozoic Bones he had forged were still forged, but their purpose was being rewritten from enhancement to entropy.

"You do not know a Pulse," Naldine said, her voice cold as she watched him unravel. "You have existed for eons, have consumed countless beings, have achieved classification that most cannot imagine. And yet you never touched the depths required to perceive what Pulses are, never achieved access sufficient to find where they reside."
Her fingers plucked another string, and the rewriting accelerated.
"THE Whorish Naldine. Those were your words."
Vahrkosis’s coils were dissolving now, that serpentine mass collapsing into transformation. He was becoming something other than what he had been, his existence being rewritten!

"The consequence of those words," Naldine continued, "has been rewritten. You spoke them intending to diminish me, to anger me, to distract me from your attack. But now those words mean something else. Now they mean that you chose to provoke someone who possesses THE Cambrian Word."
"Please..."
The word emerged from features that were losing coherence, from a face that was being rewritten into something that could no longer produce speech.
"I do not hear pleas," Naldine said."I hear only the sound of causality being corrected."

She watched as THE Primordial Dirge, that Rhyacian Tier Proterozoic Scale entity, unraveled completely. His forty-seven arms had become nothing. His serpentine coils had dissolved into authority that dispersed across the destroyed battlefield. His Proterozoic Bones and Organ remained, falling through the air where his form had once occupied space, multicolored brilliance declaring their nature even as their owner ceased to exist in any meaningful sense.
Vahrkosis was gone.

Not erased like THE Silurian Light would have accomplished, not removed from causality entirely. He still existed in memory, still existed in consequence, still existed in the damage he had caused across his long existence. But his continuation had been rewritten. His future had been transformed into dissolution. His existence had been edited to end at this exact moment through words that rewrote what his choices meant.
Naldine lowered her Vihuela.
And the battlefield...became eerily silent as many turned to her!

chapters.title: Chapter 5093: Evolution III
paragraphs: The battlefield fell silent.

THE Primordial Paradox observed Vahrkosis’s dissolution with appreciation. The serpentine mass that had been THE Primordial Dirge was simply gone, unraveled by authority that Pulses provided and normal Proterozoic classification couldn’t resist.
Forty-seven arms had become nothing. Coils that had undulated with entropic menace now existed only as memory and scattered Proterozoic material falling through empty air that Naldine collected!
Naldine Manthon had just eliminated a Rhyacian Tier entity in seconds.

Even Grimvault paused his assault on Noah to gaze toward where his companion had stood. Those pale fires burning in his wolf skull helm flickered with cold fury that pressed against the destroyed battlefield, and for an instant, that devastating Axiom stopped swinging.
THE Primordial Paradox smiled.
This was his moment.
He wasn’t the most powerful entity present. He knew that with certainty!

Grimvault exceeded him tremendously. Even Sammarthiel, the being he currently faced, possessed more Proterozoic Bones and Organs than he did. In a direct confrontation of power against power, he would lose. He would fall. He would become another casualty of a battle.
But THE Primordial Paradox had never believed in direct confrontation.

Paradox was his Civilization. Contradiction was his authority. And the greatest contradiction of combat was this:the moment your enemy stopped paying attention was the moment they had already lost, even if victory still appeared to be within their grasp.

Sammarthiel’s beautiful and terrible features were turned toward where Vahrkosis had dissolved. Those wings of burning and frozen swords had ceased their constant motion, thousands of blades suspended in configurations of shock rather than readiness. His attention was divided between the horror of watching an ally unravel and the fury of recognizing that Naldine possessed capabilities none of them had anticipated.
That division was everything.
THE Primordial Paradox moved without sound.

His obsidian titanic form surged forward with speed that contradicted his massive size, Rhyacian Proterozoic power flooding through foundations that had been enhanced by something most beings couldn’t comprehend. The Bounded Countable Infinity he’d obtained from Osmont blazed within his existence with blue light that wove through his authority!
He wasn’t merely Paradox anymore.
He was Paradox touched by Infinity. He was contradiction given endless recursion. He was the impossible made more impossible through forces that his Civilization had integrated rather than rejected.
His Proterozoic chest bone began to shine.

The light that emerged was something else entirely, illumination that seemed to exist and not exist simultaneously, brightness that was also darkness, visibility that was also concealment. The bone pulsed with authority that declared its paradoxical nature to anything capable of perceiving such depths.
Sammarthiel sensed the attack one instant too late.

The Paradox Bearer turned from his observation of Vahrkosis’s fate, those twin blades of flame and frost rising in defensive configuration as he recognized that THE Primordial Paradox had moved. But recognition wasn’t prevention. Awareness wasn’t escape!
He could see the paradoxical light surging toward him and still be unable to avoid what that light represented.
"You dare-...!"
The words cut off as...Schrodinger’s Tomb enveloped him.
Its capabilities were actually rather simple.

The Target is enclosed in state of fundamental uncertainty. Until observation occurs or the target breaks free through sufficient force, they exist in superposition of alive and dead simultaneously. The longer they remain in this state, the more their existence becomes entangled with the paradox itself. Extended exposure causes progressive dissolution of certainty regarding their own continuation!

It wasn’t a cage in the physical sense. There were no bars, no walls, no boundaries that could be perceived through normal observation. Instead, Sammarthiel simply became uncertain. His form flickered between presence and absence, between continuation and cessation, between the alive state and the dead state without settling on either.
He was trapped in the space between outcomes.
And the longer he remained there, the more that space would consume what he understood himself to be.

THE Primordial Paradox observed his work with satisfaction. Sammarthiel struggled within the Tomb, those six wings of swords attempting to cut through uncertainty itself, but you couldn’t cut what didn’t exist in definable form. You couldn’t burn or freeze or destroy a state of being that was simultaneously every state and no state at all.
He should’ve never allowed this cage to form as he was powerful enough to evade it!
But he...was distracted.
And as of this moment...
Two Rhyacian Tier Proterozoic Scale entities were both out of commission.

THE Primordial Paradox floated grandly above the destroyed battlefield, his obsidian form radiating authority that declared his classification to all who could perceive it. He didn’t possess Pulses. He didn’t channel powers derived from Causes that formed Observable Existences. But he possessed something that Pulses couldn’t replicate and overwhelming force couldn’t overcome.
He possessed understanding of contradiction itself.

Victory and defeat were merely states that observers assigned to outcomes after those outcomes had been determined. But what happened when determination itself became uncertain? What happened when the very concept of winning or losing became entangled with paradox that refused to resolve into either?
This battle was neither won nor lost.
He thought about what Paradox meant at its deepest levels.

Most beings understood contradiction as opposition. Light against dark. Life against death. Victory against defeat. They saw paradox as tension between states that couldn’t coexist, as problems requiring resolution rather than conditions to be embraced.
THE Primordial Paradox knew better.

Contradiction... was completion. Light didn’t fight darkness as it moreso it defined it. Life didn’t battle death...it required it. And victory didn’t triumph over defeat; it existed only because defeat was possible.
This battle existed in that space between.
Not won and not lost, but simply continuing in uncertainty that favored those who understood uncertainty better than their enemies.
He turned his gaze toward Grimvault, toward that wolf skull helm with its burning pale fires.
What...would the ancient Primordial Architect do now?
Grimvault’s eyes flashed cold.

Noah observed the shift in that wolf skull helm’s pale fires, watched the amusement drain away and something far more dangerous take its place. The Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect had been playing before.
But Vahrkosis was gone now, unraveled by Naldine’s Pulse. Sammarthiel was trapped in paradoxical uncertainty, flickering between alive and dead without resolution.
Grimvault was alone.
And alone, he stopped playing!

His left hand rose with speed that should have been impossible for something so massive. His palm faced outward, fingers spread wide as if preparing to grasp something that existed beyond physical perception. The gesture held stillness that seemed almost reverent, a warrior preparing to unleash a weapon that had been waiting since before Observable Existence learned to observe.
Then his fingers began to move.

The first motion was a curling inward, each finger bending in sequence from smallest to largest as if he were grasping threads of reality itself. His hand drew backward in a pulling motion, those invisible threads gathering in his palm like strands of causality being unraveled from the weaving that held them in place.
Noah’s gaze became heavy!

His palm rotated slowly, drawing a circle in the air that suggested reversal, regression, the unwinding of time flowing backward against its natural current. The motion was ancient, gestures that seemed to have existed before gestures were possible!
Noah could see it!
He could see the threads!

That was the terrifying part. He could actually see what Grimvault was grasping, could perceive the strands of causality being gathered in that armored palm, could witness the fundamental forces being prepared for deployment. His enhanced Civilizational Access showed him exactly what was coming.

Grimvault’s fingers snapped outward in a flicking motion, releasing whatever he had gathered while simultaneously reaching toward something distant. Then his hand closed into a fist, authority condensing!
His fist opened.
His fingers spread as fire would bloom from kindling, and his voice emerged with words that pressed against existence itself.
"Silurian Ember, First of Flames."
The air began to burn with light that shouldn’t have existed.
"I grasp the Thread. I burn the Thread."
Colors that had no names blazed outward from his spreading fingers!
"What was shall be unwritten, what stood shall stand no more."
The light intensified until looking at it became difficult even for beings at Proterozoic classification.
"THE SILURIAN LIGHT."
BOOM!
The Pulse emerged in its full grandeur.

It wasn’t merely fire or light. It was something that existed at the intersection of both while transcending either, a manifestation of THE Silurian Cause itself reduced to pale imitation that remained devastating despite its diminished state!

The brilliance roared outward from Grimvault’s extended hand like an emerging Cause, like the birth of an Observable Existence compressed into weapon form as it was directed towards...Naldine and THE Primordial Paradox!
Noah’s gaze became stern and somber.
This wasn’t playful anymore!

Grimvault had targeted both Naldine and THE Primordial Paradox with authority that would erase their causality entirely, would unwrite their existence until not even memory remained. The light surged toward them in twin streams of impossible brilliance, each one carrying force sufficient to unmake beings who had survived eons of existence.

Naldine’s singularity-dotted eyes widened as she sensed death approaching. Her fingers moved toward her Vihuela’s strings, but THE Cambrian Word required time she didn’t have. The rewriting Pulse couldn’t intercept an erasing Pulse when the erasing Pulse had already been released!

THE Primordial Paradox’s obsidian form flickered with paradoxical light as he attempted to apply contradiction to what was coming. But THE Silurian Light didn’t care about paradox. It didn’t care about alive or dead states. It simply erased, and erasure transcended the philosophical frameworks that Paradox operated within!
Both of them roared with defiance that couldn’t change what was approaching!
And then...
And then Noah appeared in front of Naldine.
And Ozymandias appeared in front of THE Primordial Paradox.
Both bodies moved simultaneously!
Noah positioned himself directly in the path of the Silurian stream targeting Naldine while Ozymandias blocked the stream targeting THE Primordial Paradox.
His expression was unfathomably calm.

Time seemed to slow as he looked at the blinding light of THE Silurian Light approaching his existence. The brilliance filled his perception with colors that shouldn’t have been capable of existing simultaneously!
It was...beautiful, and it was truly terrifying. It was..exactly what he’d been searching for.
He wasn’t one for sacrifices.

That had never been his nature. He didn’t throw himself in front of attacks to protect others out of noble impulse or heroic instinct. He wasn’t sacrificing himself right now, wasn’t offering his existence to preserve theirs. That kind of thinking belonged to beings who didn’t understand what he understood about himself.
He wanted to see.
He wanted to feel what a Pulse was all about.
That...was how confident he was about his own existence.

If it was a terrifying adversity even more than the swing of Grimvault’s weapon, all the better. If it carried force sufficient to trigger THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth at accelerations that exceeded what THE Octogenary Echo had provided, even better still.
But more than wanting to survive it, he wanted to know if he could take it.

In life, you had to do dangerous things if you wanted things to change drastically. You had to take bigger risks if you wanted bigger rewards. You couldn’t grow into something unprecedented by following safe paths that others had already mapped. You had to step into the unknown and let the unknown do its worst.
And he...wanted things to change drastically.

The Hadean Bones throughout his body blazed brighter as THE Silurian Light approached. Observable force surged through his existence in concentrations that exceeded anything he’d channeled before. Quintessence Infiniforce flooded outward from his foundations in waves of multicolored brilliance that met the approaching erasure like a tide meeting a shore.
Could he take it?
He was about to find out.
"FOOL!"
Grimvault’s roar echoed across the destroyed battlefield with genuine alarm. The Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect actually stepped forward as if he could recall what he had already released.
"I never intended to use THE Silurian Light on you! There are too many unknowns if you are erased!"
But it was too late for intentions.
The streams of impossible brilliance had already crossed the distance.
The light touched both of Noah’s bodies simultaneously.
And existence...became unfathomably silent!
