sentences.text: <Fragment of awareness attributed to THE Deliverance>
In spans that predated the concept of spans, THE Deliverance had observed the nature of advancement with attention that most beings could not sustain across even a fraction of such duration.
It had watched countless existences conflate two processes which were, upon examination that required no effort for something of its nature, quite fundamentally distinct from one another.
Transcendance and Ascension.

Transcendence referred to the elevation of existence beyond its current categorical limitations, the movement from one classification to another in ways that redefined what the being fundamentally was.
Ascension represented advancement within one’s existing classification, the refinement and expansion of capabilities without actually changing the foundational nature of the existence in question.
The distinction mattered.
Those who failed to understand this failed at everything that followed.
A Primordial Architect who forged additional Proterozoic Bones, who cultivated new Organs, who progressed from Rhyacian to Calymmian to Ediacaran, this being was ascending.
They grew more powerful.
They remained what they always were.
Their classification did not change; only their position within that classification elevated.
THE Deliverance had observed this process unfold across eons beyond counting, had watched beings celebrate advancements that changed nothing fundamental about their nature.
He had been foolish enough to ask before...if one desired to transform from THE Bounded status to THE Gilded status, would such a transformation be considered transcendence?
The asking itself long ago revealed his own fundamental misunderstanding of how existence had been woven.
It was not possible to transform from Bounded to Gilded.
This was not difficulty or a ceiling.
The distinctions between Bounded and Gilded were established permanently, and those distinctions were permanent by design.
They were not limitations to be overcome.
They were definitions.One did not transcend a definition; one simply was or was not what the definition described.
Even if a Gilded Lifeform sealed themselves to live as Bounded.
They walked among those they were engineered to surpass.
They experienced limitations never meant for them.
Even when they forgot what they truly were.
But forgetting changed nothing.
The seal suppressed expression.
It did not alter engineering.
Remove the seal, and what was always there reasserted itself.
The Bounded lifeform beside them could remove a thousand seals and would remain precisely what they were at first breath:Bounded.
Limited by design.
Constrained by intention that predated their existence by margins they could not comprehend.
This truth simply was.
And those who failed to understand it would continue failing, as they always had, as they always would, until existence itself concluded its long and patient turning.
Existence breathes, and epochs pass, leaving Civilizations that become monuments, then crumble to memory, and are long forgotten when that breath comes again.
In all these epochs, Infinity reigns supreme.
The entire region had transformed into something...unimaginable.
Tumultuous primordial seas of gold Observable Force stretched in every direction, waves crashing against waves in configurations that had nothing to do with gravity or current.
Multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce wove through those golden seas like rivers of impossible light threading through an ocean that shouldn’t have existed.
The destroyed battlefield was gone now, replaced by this churning expanse of raw authority that had gathered in response to what was occurring at its center.
Typhoons bloomed across the surface of these seas.

Storms of Observable Force twisted into spiraling columns that reached toward heights that most beings couldn’t perceive, their rotation carrying enough power to obliterate Absolutes who strayed too close.
Lightning made of Quintessence Infiniforce arced between the typhoons, connecting them in networks of multicolored brilliance that painted the entire region in hues of transformation and genesis.
And at the very center of it all, Noah could feel his body undergoing the last cycles of destruction and rebirth.
It was taking longer and longer for THE Silurian Light to be capable of destroying his atoms and cells.
Dozens of nanoseconds before this, he’d actually had to release any natural passive defenses, consciously lowering the resistance his transforming existence had developed.
Otherwise, he might not have been able to undergo the cycles of destruction at all.
The fire that had once threatened to erase him entirely now struggled to even damage cells that had been rebuilt so many times they’d forgotten what weakness felt like.
But finally, after cycles beyond counting, after transformation that had compressed eons into minutes, the moment arrived.
BOOM!
The magma-like light blazed for one last moment.
It pressed against his existence with everything it had remaining, that fire derived from THE Silurian Cause attempting one final assault on foundations that had grown too grand for it to damage.
The flames cried out as if giving up, a sound that wasn’t sound but rather the sensation of authority recognizing its own inadequacy.
And everything about it faded.
THE Silurian Light, the Pulse that Grimvault had unleashed to erase him, the fire that had scorched his existence through countless nanoseconds of destruction and rebirth, simply ceased.
Its purpose had been exhausted.
Its power had been absorbed.
Nothing remained but the aftermath of what it had catalyzed!
Noah floated at the center of the primordial seas with his eyes closed.
His body still burned with residual heat that had nothing to do with the departed Pulse, warmth generated by transformation that was reaching its culmination.
He raised his hands up, palms facing the churning sky of Observable Force that stretched above this impossible region.
HUUM!
His last cycle of destruction displayed itself to all who were watching.
His entire body broke apart into pure particles of Infinity and Observable Force, form dissolving into components so fundamental that they preceded the concept of form itself.
Ozymandias underwent the same dissolution simultaneously, that titanic frame shattering into brilliance that matched what Noah’s smaller body had become.
A blinding light bloomed across the primordial seas.
Even Alexander turned his eyes away from what he was witnessing.
Naldine, who had observed phenomena across eons of existence among Primordial Architects, shielded her singularity-dotted gaze!
THE Primordial Paradox shifted his obsidian form away from the epicenter!
The light folded back.
Particles of Infinity and Observable Force that had scattered across the primordial seas began converging, drawn together.

They coalesced with purpose that declared their destination, streams of brilliance flowing toward a central point where form was being reconstructed from components that had been purified through cycles beyond counting.
Noah’s body emerged from the convergence shining unfathomably gold.
His hair now radiated with multicolored light that shifted through hues as his existence settled into its new configuration.

The strands seemed to contain depths that normal hair couldn’t possess, each one blazing with Quintessence Infiniforce that had been integrated so thoroughly it had become part of his physical appearance.
His fair skin illuminated from within, golden light pressing outward through flesh that had been rebuilt at the subatomic level.
The illumination wasn’t harsh or aggressive.
It simply was, the natural consequence of foundations saturated with Observable Force at densities that Bounded classification shouldn’t have been able to contain.
And for a moment, momentarily visible to Naldine and all others present, the outline of his internal structure revealed itself through that illuminated skin.
An entirely crystalline multicolored golden skeleton.
Every bone blazed with brilliance that declared its transformation complete, structures that had once been mundane now existing as something that exceeded Proterozoic classification entirely.
The skull.
The spine.
The ribcage.
The pelvis.
Every arm bone and leg bone and hand bone and foot bone, all of them shining with authority that made the Proterozoic Bones of fallen Primordial Architects seem dim by comparison!
And apart from the skeleton, there were radiant crystalline Organs.
His heart pulsed with golden light that pressed outward through his chest.
His lungs expanded and contracted with brilliance.
His brain blazed brightest of all!
The massive obsidian form of Ozymandias had undergone similar transformation.

That titanic frame now radiated with the same golden brilliance that Noah’s smaller body displayed, crystalline structures visible beneath flesh that had been rebuilt through the same cycles of destruction and rebirth.
Where there had been one transformed body, now there were two, both shining with authority that exceeded what THE Second Scale was supposed to represent.
Noah opened his eyes.
The simple act felt like the opening of ancient doors, lids rising to reveal what lay behind them with significance that pressed against all surrounding authority!
HUUM!
The primordial seas trembled.
The typhoons of Observable Force stuttered in their rotation.
The lightning of Quintessence Infiniforce paused mid-arc as if waiting to see what those newly opened eyes would observe.
He raised his hand and looked at himself.
He felt brand new.
Brand new, as if he’d never existed before this moment, as if everything that had come before was merely preparation for what he had just become.
And just by raising his hand...
HUUM!
His movement was accompanied by terrifying force that he hadn’t consciously intended.
A blinding gold brilliance erupted from the simple gesture, nearby existence twisting in response!

A beam of golden light tore across space from his raised fingers, carving through the primordial seas with power that could have caused a Rhyacian Proterozoic Lifeform like Beowulf to go pale with terror!
He...hadn’t meant to do that.
He stopped any movements immediately, recognizing that his new existence required calibration he hadn’t yet performed.
His eyes closed again as he turned his attention inward, seeking to sense the changes that had occurred through cycles of transformation he’d lost count of long ago.
The prompts rained down as they felt...sublime.
Ruination’s voice and words felt sublime!

chapters.title: Chapter 5099: Information Is Critical!
paragraphs: Nakatsukuni’s deepest reaches.

Erwin stood before the structure where Sadakar resided, his beggar-like attire seeming almost offensive against the refined architecture surrounding him. Moloch floated beside him, golden plates spinning with consideration.
Both of them had paused before the doorway where Sabayne and Ba’alzan sat guard, their attention directed not at the entrance but upward toward the sky that stretched above this hidden domain.
The broadcast had been dispersed.

Grimvault had shattered the illusory screens that had been displaying his confrontation across Observable Existence, denying most beings the ability to witness what had occurred in THE Wastes. Very few possessed the capability to observe through such disruption. Very few could pierce the veil that a Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect had thrown across the event.
Moloch was one of them. His nature as a Singular Cognizance granted perception that others couldn’t imagine.
And Erwin was another.

His existence as THE Information Paradox allowed him to consume information that others couldn’t access. Even when that information was scattered, even when it was hidden, even when powerful entities actively worked to prevent its spread, the paradox he embodied could draw fragments toward himself through sheer contradiction of the principle that hidden things should remain hidden.
He didn’t see the full picture.

The details were incomplete, the sequence of events fragmented in ways that made comprehensive understanding impossible. But he saw enough. He saw Grimvault’s Silurian Light crash against an existence that should have been erased by it. He saw that existence survive. He saw a Pulse emerge in response, blue gold flames that made even his paradoxical perception struggle to process what they represented.
And he saw Grimvault flee.
Erwin smiled brilliantly.
His lips curved upward! Even with limited information, even with gaps in his observation that would have frustrated lesser beings, he could affirm one undeniable fact.
Osmont had somehow managed to push away a Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity.
He had forced an entity who had existed since before most current powers learned to crawl to tear open THE Interstices and flee rather than continue the confrontation.
This made him tremendously happy.

Since his conversation with Osmont in that space between spaces, since revealing his nature as THE Information Paradox and watching his Infinite Seals interweave with the corrupted proto-matter of THE Fallout, before all of it had been erased with multicolored rain, Erwin had made a decision. He had changed his target for information gathering. Where before he had focused his paradoxical consumption on THE Creature, now his attention had shifted.
To Osmont.
Not because he believed Osmont was grander than THE Creature.That couldn’t possibly be true. Or rather, he couldn’t really know that with certainty.
THE Creature had existed for far to long and done far too much.
But his paradoxical intuition told him to make this change.

That intuition, which had guided him through eons of cultivation and consumption and contradiction, whispered that Osmont represented information worth gathering. Worth focusing on. Worth making the center of his attention rather than an entity whose patterns he had already observed across countless spans of existence.
And now, confirming what Osmont had just accomplished...
Erwin spoke commandingly, his voice emerging with authority that pressed against the stillness of Nakatsukuni’s deepest reaches.
"Harvest all the information of how Osmont has affected Observable Existence since then."
His words weren’t directed at anyone present. They were directed at himself, at the paradox he embodied, at the violation of information conservation that comprised his fundamental nature.

"Gather every fragment of how much potential he has taken and displayed in the surrounding existence. All the weavings that carry his signature. All the effects that trace back to his actions. All of it."
HUUM!
His body shone internally with paradoxical light.

The brilliance existed and didn’t exist simultaneously, illumination that was also darkness, visibility that was also concealment. Information began flooding toward his existence in torrents that made even his eons-refined foundations tremble. He felt the consumption begin, felt the paradox draw in everything related to Osmont’s effects on Observable Existence.
And what flooded toward him almost made him shudder.

The amount was ridiculous. The density was overwhelming. Information about Osmont’s Infinity spreading across realms. Information about his Seals now interweaving with THE Fallout. Information about Civilizations and Undivided Ones and Formless Terrors who had been affected by his emergence. Information about The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity he actually formed alongside THE Creature, and so much more!

Instead of releasing this information outward as he normally would, instead of letting it spread as weavings that carried his signature alongside their original essence, Erwin released all of it into...himself.
He sat down in a meditative position.

His beggar-like form settled against the ground before Sadakar’s structure, legs crossing beneath him as the paradoxical light within his existence intensified. Sabayne and Ba’alzan watched him with expressions that mixed confusion and wariness, clearly uncertain what THE Living Paradox was doing at their doorstep.
But Erwin paid them no attention.
His Civilizational Anchor was settling.

He could feel it happening. The information he had just consumed, the sheer magnitude of Osmont’s effects on Observable Existence, provided the final weight needed to push his paradox past the threshold he had been approaching for so long.
Apart from this, endless paradoxical Observable Force began flooding into him.

Golden light mixed with the contradictory brilliance already burning within his foundations, power that came from sources he couldn’t immediately identify but didn’t question. His cultivation accelerated in ways that felt almost unfair!
Erwin opened his eyes with wonder that he rarely allowed himself to feel.
Just what was Osmont?

How was merely the information related to him and his effect on surrounding existence this grand? He hadn’t consumed Osmont himself. He had only gathered information about Osmont’s effects, about how his existence rippled outward through Observable Existence, about the changes his emergence had created across existence.
And that alone had been sufficient to push him past the threshold of Civilizational Anchor.

Erwin shook his head slowly. He focused on his rapid elevation of power, on the forces flooding into his existence with intensity. His paradox burned brighter than ever, contradiction and confirmation dancing within foundations that were transforming into something grander with every passing moment.
Above him, Moloch floated with golden plates spinning faster than normal.

The Singular Cognizance seemed thoughtful. Only now did Moloch seem to truly notice Erwin, attention shifting from whatever he had been contemplating to focus on the entity sitting in meditation below him.
A heavy power was erupting from THE Living Paradox.

Moloch’s plates slowed as that power pressed against his perception, as the advancement occurring within Erwin announced itself to everything nearby. The Singular Cognizance had brought Erwin here to make difficult allies, to secure partnerships with entities who had rejected conflict. He hadn’t expected his companion to achieve a breakthrough on the doorstep of their destination.
And neither Moloch nor Erwin knew what waited just beyond the doorway they stood outside of.

On the other side of that entrance, within the stellar darkness of Sadakar’s structure, another body of Noah Osmont stood. The very entity whose information had just catalyzed Erwin’s breakthrough was right there, separated from them by nothing more than wood and stone and the power of Sadakar who separated them!
The Peasant and the Infinity-bearer, about to meet again!

Apart from this, endless paradoxical Observable Force began flooding into him.
Golden light mixed with the contradictory brilliance already burning within his foundations, power that came from sources he couldn’t immediately identify but didn’t question.
His cultivation accelerated in ways that felt almost unfair!
Erwin opened his eyes with wonder that he rarely allowed himself to feel.
Just what was Osmont?
How was merely the information related to him and his effect on surrounding existence this grand?
He hadn’t consumed Osmont himself.
He had only gathered information about Osmont’s effects, about how his existence rippled outward through Observable Existence, about the changes his emergence had created across existence.
And that alone had been sufficient to push him past the threshold of Civilizational Anchor.
Erwin shook his head slowly.
He focused on his rapid elevation of power, on the forces flooding into his existence with intensity.
His paradox burned brighter than ever, contradiction and confirmation dancing within foundations that were transforming into something grander with every passing moment.
Above him, Moloch floated with golden plates spinning faster than normal.
The Singular Cognizance seemed thoughtful.
Only now did Moloch seem to truly notice Erwin, attention shifting from whatever he had been contemplating to focus on the entity sitting in meditation below him.
A heavy power was erupting from THE Living Paradox.
Moloch’s plates slowed as that power pressed against his perception, as the advancement occurring within Erwin announced itself to everything nearby.
The Singular Cognizance had brought Erwin here to make difficult allies, to secure partnerships with entities who had rejected conflict.
He hadn’t expected his companion to achieve a breakthrough on the doorstep of their destination.
And neither Moloch nor Erwin knew what waited just beyond the doorway they stood outside of.
On the other side of that entrance, within the stellar darkness of Sadakar’s structure, another body of Noah Osmont stood.
The very entity whose information had just catalyzed Erwin’s breakthrough was right there, separated from them by nothing more than wood and stone and the power of Sadakar who separated them!
The Peasant and the Infinity-bearer, about to meet again!

chapters.title: Chapter 5100: Experimentation I
paragraphs: Noah gazed toward Ozymandias.

His second body floated nearby in that transformed obsidian form, crystalline structures now visible beneath flesh that radiated the same golden brilliance his primary body displayed. They had undergone the same evolution through the same cycles of destruction and rebirth, both existences now Hadean in classification.
He sent the command through THE Hadean Organ of Civilization.

Ozymandias dissolved into streams of blue gold light that flowed across the tumultuous seas of Observable Force surrounding them. Those streams entered Noah’s chest, returning to THE Hadean Desmoterion where the titanic form would cultivate until needed again.
Noah looked at his hands.

Golden light still pressed outward through skin that seemed luminescent rather than merely fair. Everything about his existence felt different now, grander in ways he was still learning to comprehend.
Just what had his power reached at this time?
And what did it truly mean to be a Hadean Lifeform?
He turned his attention inward, directing his question inward.
"Ruination...am I still considered a Bounded Lifeform?"
The response came calmly.

|I find myself perceiving and obtaining information from our surroundings at rates that exceed my previous capacity by factors I am still calculating. Dozens of times faster, certainly. Dozens of times denser in the quality of what I can observe. The transformation you have undergone has elevated my own capabilities tremendously.|
A pause that felt contemplative rather than hesitant.

|As for your question regarding classification, the answer is not as simple as you might hope. You cannot be considered a Bounded Lifeform any longer. The limitations that define Bounded existence, the ceilings engineered into their foundations, the restrictions that prevent them from accessing Observable Force at densities reserved for higher classifications, none of these apply to you in your current state.|

|However, you are not a Gilded Lifeform either. The engineering that distinguishes Gilded from Bounded was not something you possessed at birth, and becoming Hadean has not retroactively granted you that engineering. You have achieved something else entirely, something that exists in territories I do not have sufficient reference points to map with confidence.|

|Even saying you exist between Bounded and Gilded may not be entirely accurate. You are Hadean. This classification seems to operate according to principles that do not align neatly with the spectrum that places Bounded at one end and Gilded at the other. It is rather difficult to measure your current state in terms of difference between those two categories.|

|What I can state definitively is this: as of right now, you remain lower than a Gilded Lifeform such as Ubergulden Adelheid. Her engineering grants her advantages that your transformation, impressive as it is, has not replicated. But the gap between you and such entities has narrowed considerably, and given your trajectory, I would not assume that gap to be permanent.|
Right.
Ubergulden Adelheid.

Noah let that name roll through his awareness with consideration it deserved. Such a strange and grand name for someone who had presented herself as THE Secretive Eon, who had sealed her Gilded nature to live as Bounded. The cadence of the name suggested origins and traditions he knew nothing about, cultures among THE Gilded that existed beyond what his current knowledge could encompass.
She had been providing him Observable Force throughout his transformation. That connection still pulsed with warmth.
"Tell me more about her," Noah said. "About Ubergulden Adelheid and what you’ve learned through our connection."

|I have been conducting a silent and secret analysis of her existence through the link she established, and I am pleased to report that sufficient examination has been completed to allow for meaningful interaction. Her engineering remains perceivable to your newly unlocked Existential Engineering capability.|

|Most relevantly for your immediate circumstances, you now possess the ability to communicate with her directly. The connection she established flows in both directions, and with your enhanced processing capabilities, you can easily send a message through that link for her to hear. Whether she chooses to respond, of course, remains her decision to make.|
Well, that was something.
He filed that capability away for future use, recognizing that such communication would need to be approached with care given how little he still understood about her.
While he was thinking about all of this, movement drew his attention outward.

Naldine Manthon floated toward him through the tumultuous seas of Observable Force. Her singularity-dotted eyes blazed with intensity, ancient perception clearly working through what she was observing. She circled him slowly, her radiant white hair trailing behind her as she moved, her expression holding something between fascination and confusion.
She reached out and lifted his arm.

Her fingers pressed against his transformed flesh as if testing its composition, as if checking whether his structure matched what her senses were telling her. She turned his hand over, examined his palm, traced lines across his skin that seemed to follow pathways only she could perceive.
"What... are you, really?"
The question emerged with genuine bewilderment that she didn’t bother concealing.

Noah smiled at the familiar inquiry. He felt like he had been asked this before, many times, by entities across various classifications who couldn’t reconcile what they observed with what they understood to be possible.
Now Naldine Manthon asked the same question with the same inability to find satisfying answers.
He clenched his fist, feeling the power that coursed through transformed flesh and Hadean bone.
"You can help me find out."
His voice hels confidence that pressed against the surrounding seas of Observable Force.
"I need to test the extent of my new power, and you might make a good sparring partner."
Naldine’s eyes became sharp at these words. The Vihuela formed from her own arm began to hum with authority that announced her classification to everything nearby.
Before she could reply, movement from another direction drew both their attention.

THE Primordial Paradox floated toward them through the multicolored seas, his massive obsidian form cutting through the tumultuous Observable Force. Behind him, pulled by chains of paradoxical light, Schrodinger’s Tomb drifted in his wake. Sammarthiel remained trapped within that uncertainty, flickering between alive and dead without resolution.
The ancient being looked at Noah with seriousness that his obsidian features somehow conveyed despite their inhuman nature.
"Youngest."
His voice pressed against everything nearby.

"I have returned after eons of absence, and I have much to catch up on in Helheim among other places. Old debts to collect or repay depending on how the accounting has shifted during my imprisonment."
He paused, his gaze holding something that might have been respect.
"I will keep in touch."
Noah nodded at him with a smile.
"Stay safe," Noah said. "For existence is vast and full of terrors."
THE Primordial Paradox laughed at such words as he had said them himself what seemed like eons ago!
His obsidian form shook with that laughter, paradoxical light flickering across his features.
"Indeed it is, Youngest. Indeed it is!"

He turned away, pulling on the chains that connected him to Schrodinger’s Tomb. The massive prison of uncertainty drifted behind him as he moved toward the edge of the tumultuous seas, toward regions where the multicolored rain of THE Pluvial Epoch fell with intensity.
And then he disappeared into that rain, his obsidian form swallowed by cascading brilliance while dragging a Rhyacian Tier Primordial Architect trapped in paradoxical uncertainty behind him.
Alexander looked between Noah and Naldine.

His Enneagram pulsed with the dangerous light it had held since completing his work on Beowulf, nine points blazing with authority that seemed more substantial than it had been before this battle began. The network of Second Scale Existential Nociceptors now integrated into his existence hummed with potential that would take time to fully realize.
He let out a sigh of peace.

It was a strange sound coming from someone who had spent millions of subjective years being tortured, someone whose entire existence had been defined by agony inflicted by the entity now imprisoned within Noah’s chest. But the sigh carried contentment.
"I know my limits and what can happen now."
His voice held calm that matched the peaceful sigh.

"While I won’t do too much, won’t overextend myself into situations I can’t handle, I feel like hunting Primordial Architects. There are many across Observable Existence who operate like Beowulf did. Many who deserve what I will bring to them."
His eyes met Noah’s with understanding that didn’t require elaboration.
"If I meet a wall that is too sturdy, I will let you know."

Noah nodded at these words with a smile. Alexander had his own path now, his own trajectory that would carry him toward heights that most couldn’t imagine reaching. The receptors of a Second Scale entity transplanted into his existence would provide advantages others couldn’t imagine as his foundation!
"Hunt well," Noah said simply.

Alexander turned and walked into the multicolored seas surrounding them. His figure moved through the tumultuous Observable Force with purpose, his form gradually becoming obscured as endless rain buffeted his existence from every direction. THE Pluvial Epoch’s downpour swallowed him just as it had swallowed THE Primordial Paradox, leaving no trace of his passage.
Noah watched him go.

With the receptors of a Second Scale transplanted into him, Alexander’s power would be experiencing a tremendous curve. He simply had to avoid meeting ridiculous adversity like Horus and Beowulf had represented, entities who exceeded him so vastly that even his new advantages couldn’t bridge the gap.
But he had his own path.
And that path was his to walk.
Only Noah and Naldine remained in this region now.

The tumultuous seas of Observable Force churned around them, golden brilliance mixing with multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce. The typhoons still spiraled in the distance. The lightning still arced between storm systems. And two beings floated at the center of it all, one newly transformed and one ancient beyond comprehension.
Noah turned to face Naldine fully.
"Are you ready, Naldine Manthon?"
His voice carried challenge that pressed against her existence!

"You have always been so high and mighty, looking at me from classifications I couldn’t reach, speaking of dangers I couldn’t understand. I wish to see if I am still far from you, or whether in our short time together, I have gone ahead of you."
He smiled devilishly as he said this. His multicolored hair blazed brighter. His golden skin illuminated with intensity that made looking at him difficult!
His pupils, shining like singularities of an unfathomable Cause, fixed upon her with attention that didn’t waver.
Naldine looked at him with sharp eyes.

The Vihuela in her hands buzzed with authority that exceeded what she had displayed during the battle against Grimvault and his companions. Her singularity-dotted gaze held something between anticipation and wariness, ancient existence recognizing that the being before her was no longer what he had been when she first agreed to teach him!
She floated away from him, putting distance between them that combat would require.
"Since my perception cannot fully understand you, I won’t be taking it easy."
Her voice carried seriousness that matched her expression.
"Whatever you have become, it exists in territories I cannot map. And things I cannot map are things that can hurt me if I underestimate them."
Billowing power began to gather around her.

Observable Force flooded toward her...and blue infinity faintly shone inside her. Her Proterozoic Bones blazed with authority that pressed against the tumultuous seas surrounding them. Her Proterozoic Organs pulsed with rhythms!
Truly, she seemed to be past the door of Calymmian Proterozoic Scale.
Noah nodded at her words seriously.
"Oh, you definitely should not take it easy."
His voice pressed against existence itself.
"Otherwise, you may not survive."
BOOM!
He simply took a step forward.
And existence itself shook as if he was commanding all the Observable Force nearby, as if his movement had become authority that reality couldn’t ignore. The tumultuous seas parted around him!
The typhoons in the distance stuttered in their rotation. The lightning froze mid-arc as if waiting to see what would happen next!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 5101: Experimentation II
paragraphs: In THE Infiniverse.
The Early Veiled Shore stretched before Noah’s perception with magisterial beauty that felt almost absurd given everything happening across Observable Existence!

Vibrant golden sand lined the beach where waves of crystalline water lapped against shores that had never known pollution or corruption. Inland, plots of multicolored farmland spread across gentle hills, sacred herbs of every variety growing vibrantly.
The multicolored rain of THE Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity continued even here.

Droplets of impossible brilliance fell, nourishing everything they touched with Quintessence Infiniforce that accelerated growth and enhanced potency. The herbs seemed to lean toward the rain as it fell, leaves spreading wider to catch more of what descended upon them.
On a plot filled with mystical floating lotuses, Noah stood with attention fixed on something far more interesting than sacred herbs.

Another body of his had just begun sparring with Naldine Manthon in the tumultuous seas of Observable Force that THE Wastes had become. That confrontation would test the limits of his Hadean transformation against someone who stood past the door of Calymmian classification. But this body, this consciousness operating within THE Infiniverse itself, had different work to accomplish.
Critical work.

A floating platform of soft luminescent material hovered among the mystical lotuses, their multicolored petals releasing fragrances that would have intoxicated lesser beings. And on that platform layBarbatos.
Her short stature seemed almost delicate against the soft surface supporting her, dark hair splayed outward in waves that caught the light of Infinity.

That hair seemed to drink in the multicolored rain, strands glistening with moisture that carried power most beings couldn’t safely absorb. Her voluptuous figure was adorned in nothing but a loose white robe that revealed curves that drew attention regardless of how many times he had seen them.
She was breathing with relief now, chest rising and falling as she recovered from what he had just done.
He had pulled her from Yggdrheim without warning, extracted her from challenges she had been navigating within that realm of trials and tribulations.
Her dark eyes opened to look at him with an expression mixing curiosity and something more suggestive.
"When you pulled me away from Yggdrheim while saying you wanted to try something, I had an entirely different idea in mind regarding what we would be trying."
"I imagined candles, perhaps. Certainly not being placed on a table like a specimen awaiting dissection."
She propped herself up on her elbows, the movement causing her robe to shift mesmerizingly.
"What exactly are you planning on doing, Little Fish?"
Little Fish.
She still used this term regardless of how his power had grown, and he found comfort in that consistency all the way from his time in Atlantis!
It was surreal to think about his time years ago as an Atlantean fighting demons.
Noah’s eyes were already shining like golden singularities as he looked at her.
"I want to see if I have what it takes to be an Engineer."
An Engineer.

Because he had gained the capability of Existential Engineering through his Hadean transformation. The ability to perceive the fundamental makeup of existence, to see the weavings that comprised beings at their most basic level, to potentially modify those weavings according to his will. He had not yet tested this capability, had not yet attempted to actually engineer anything.
He wanted to experiment now.

It seemed like something pivotal, a capability that could reshape how he approached advancement for himself and those connected to him. And this moment was as good as any to begin understanding what Existential Engineering truly allowed.
And this was a unqiue period.
Noah loved the relaxing period after major adversity.

Such times allowed him to breathe and gauge just how much he had grown. They provided space for experimentation, for exploration, for testing new capabilities without the pressure of enemies trying to kill him while he learned. Periods like this were rare. Sometimes he went from adversity to adversity without rest, from battle to breakthrough to battle again in cycles that left no room for contemplation.
One needed rest every now and then.
And his version of resting was keeping himself busy with work that didn’t involve immediate mortal danger.
Right now, that meant staring at the body of Barbatos with eyes that perceived existence differently than they ever had before.
"Lie back," he said softly.

She complied with curiosity burning in her dark eyes, settling against the soft platform while watching him with attention that missed nothing. Her robe shifted again as she moved, but neither of them paid that any mind. This was not about intimacy. This was about something potentially far more significant.
Noah brought his hands forward.

His palms pressed against various points of Barbatos’s body in a purposeful manner, fingers finding positions that his newly awakened perception identified as significant. Golden Observable Force gathered in one hand. Multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce gathered in the other. Both energies danced from his fingertips, entering her body through pathways that only Existential Engineering could perceive.
Barbatos closed her eyes and bit her lip.

The sensation was clearly stimulating. Her fingers curled against the soft platform beneath her. But she did her best to focus, to remain still, because she could see that Noah was serious about whatever he was attempting.
He infused her with tendrils of both forces, threading power through her existence!
And then he saw it.
A network of vibrant vessel-like pathways lit up across her entire body, illuminating beneath her skin in patterns that revealed the fundamental architecture of her existence.
Ethereal channels branched throughout her form like rivers feeding into tributaries feeding into streams.

Primary conduits ran along her spine and through her heart, connecting to secondary pathways that spread toward her extremities. Tertiary networks webbed between those secondary channels, creating interconnected systems that touched every part of her existence. Nodes of concentrated energy marked junctions where multiple pathways intersected, some burning bright while others barely flickered.
Her Civilization of Necromancy wove through these networks in intricate musings, death-aspected authority filled with Bounded Countable Infinity coloring the channels it had claimed.
But as Noah observed with eyes that could finally perceive such depths, he noticed something that made his expression shift.
The networks looked dim!

Her voluptuous figure was adorned in nothing but a loose white robe that revealed curves that drew attention regardless of how many times he had seen them.
She was breathing with relief now, chest rising and falling as she recovered from what he had just done.
He had pulled her from Yggdrheim without warning, extracted her from challenges she had been navigating within that realm of trials and tribulations.
Her dark eyes opened to look at him with an expression mixing curiosity and something more suggestive.
"When you pulled me away from Yggdrheim while saying you wanted to try something, I had an entirely different idea in mind regarding what we would be trying."
"I imagined candles, perhaps.
Certainly not being placed on a table like a specimen awaiting dissection."
She propped herself up on her elbows, the movement causing her robe to shift mesmerizingly.
"What exactly are you planning on doing, Little Fish?"
Little Fish.
She still used this term regardless of how his power had grown, and he found comfort in that consistency all the way from his time in Atlantis!
It was surreal to think about his time years ago as an Atlantean fighting demons.
Noah’s eyes were already shining like golden singularities as he looked at her.
"I want to see if I have what it takes to be an Engineer."
An Engineer.
Because he had gained the capability of Existential Engineering through his Hadean transformation.
The ability to perceive the fundamental makeup of existence, to see the weavings that comprised beings at their most basic level, to potentially modify those weavings according to his will.
He had not yet tested this capability, had not yet attempted to actually engineer anything.
He wanted to experiment now.
It seemed like something pivotal, a capability that could reshape how he approached advancement for himself and those connected to him.
And this moment was as good as any to begin understanding what Existential Engineering truly allowed.
And this was a unqiue period.
Noah loved the relaxing period after major adversity.
Such times allowed him to breathe and gauge just how much he had grown.
They provided space for experimentation, for exploration, for testing new capabilities without the pressure of enemies trying to kill him while he learned.
Periods like this were rare.
Sometimes he went from adversity to adversity without rest, from battle to breakthrough to battle again in cycles that left no room for contemplation.
One needed rest every now and then.
And his version of resting was keeping himself busy with work that didn’t involve immediate mortal danger.
Right now, that meant staring at the body of Barbatos with eyes that perceived existence differently than they ever had before.
"Lie back," he said softly.
She complied with curiosity burning in her dark eyes, settling against the soft platform while watching him with attention that missed nothing.
Her robe shifted again as she moved, but neither of them paid that any mind.
This was not about intimacy.
This was about something potentially far more significant.
Noah brought his hands forward.
His palms pressed against various points of Barbatos’s body in a purposeful manner, fingers finding positions that his newly awakened perception identified as significant.
Golden Observable Force gathered in one hand.
Multicolored Quintessence Infiniforce gathered in the other.
Both energies danced from his fingertips, entering her body through pathways that only Existential Engineering could perceive.
Barbatos closed her eyes and bit her lip.
The sensation was clearly stimulating.
Her fingers curled against the soft platform beneath her.
But she did her best to focus, to remain still, because she could see that Noah was serious about whatever he was attempting.
He infused her with tendrils of both forces, threading power through her existence!
And then he saw it.
A network of vibrant vessel-like pathways lit up across her entire body, illuminating beneath her skin in patterns that revealed the fundamental architecture of her existence.
Ethereal channels branched throughout her form like rivers feeding into tributaries feeding into streams.
Primary conduits ran along her spine and through her heart, connecting to secondary pathways that spread toward her extremities.
Tertiary networks webbed between those secondary channels, creating interconnected systems that touched every part of her existence.
Nodes of concentrated energy marked junctions where multiple pathways intersected, some burning bright while others barely flickered.
Her Civilization of Necromancy wove through these networks in intricate musings, death-aspected authority filled with Bounded Countable Infinity coloring the channels it had claimed.
But as Noah observed with eyes that could finally perceive such depths, he noticed something that made his expression shift.
The networks looked dim!

chapters.title: Chapter 5102: Experimentation III
paragraphs: In many areas, they seemed actively deficient, pathways that should have blazed with power instead flickering weakly or barely registering at all. The architecture was present, the potential was there, but something fundamental prevented that potential from being realized.
|I have completed preliminary analysis of the subject’s Existential Engineering.|
Ruination’s voice emerged.

|What you perceive before you is theLattice of Foundational Constraint. This is the basal, most basic perceivable engineering to you currently that defines Bounded Lifeforms, the architecture that was thr blueprint woven into their existence. The network you observe represents the channels through which power should flow and the nodes where that power should accumulate.|

|In Bounded existence, these channels are narrow. The nodes are dimmed. The potential for expansion exists within the architecture, but limitations prevent that expansion from occurring regardless of how much power the subject attempts to cultivate. This...is not deficiency in the conventional sense. This is engineering. Deliberate, precise engineering that establishes ceilings the Bounded cannot surpass through normal means. It is the base template of Existences that will ever be born in Observable Existence.|
HUUM!

|The subject Barbatos displays this Lattice of Foundational Constraint in typical Bounded configuration. Her Civilization and your infinity has optimized what can be optimized within these limitations, but she cannot exceed what she was engineered to be. The channels will not widen. The nodes will not brighten. The ceilings will not lift regardless of her efforts or desires.|
|However.|

|Through Existential Engineering, it is theoretically possible to alter this seemingly preset and unchangeable construct. The limitations are just that, which means they can be removed or modified by one possessing sufficient capability and power.If you were to flood her Lattice with Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce and overwhelm the constraints, you could potentially reshape her engineering toward something approaching Hadean classification.|

|I should note that this would not immediately transform her into a full Hadean Lifeform. Her bones and organs would remain in their current state until she undergoes the transformation process that you experienced. But her engineering would be altered to permit such transformation, to allow her existence to grow toward classifications that Bounded existence normally cannot achieve.|

|If successful, she would be designated as aNascent Hadean. A Hadean Lifeform that has not yet grown to full maturity but possesses the potential to do so. The engineering of a Hadean without the completed physical transformation. A seedling rather than a tree.|
Noah absorbed this information with eyes that blazed brighter by the moment.
A Nascent Hadean.

The possibility of granting others the potential he had achieved through cycles of destruction and rebirth that most couldn’t survive. If he could reshape Bounded engineering through Existential Engineering, if he could remove the limitations that prevented his companions from advancing beyond their designated ceilings...
His hands began to vibrate with immensity.

One hand shone gold with endless Observable Force. The other shone multicolored with endless Quintessence Infiniforce, the energy of his transformation gathering with density that pressed against everything nearby.
He looked down at Barbatos.
"This may be intense," he said simply.
Her dark eyes met his with trust that didn’t waver.
"Go on, Little Fish. Do what you need to do."
Noah pressed both hands against her heart.

He began to flood both forces into her existence, Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce pouring through her Lattice of Foundational Constraint in torrents that exceeded anything she had ever experienced. The power pressed against their walls. It pushed against the narrowing. It demanded expansion that the engineering had been designed to prevent!
Barbatos opened her eyes wide.
Her hand shot out to grasp onto his robe. Her chest heaved as her breathing became ragged, back arching off the platform as sensations cascaded through her existence in waves she couldn’t control!
BOOM!
Immense concentrations flooded into her engineering.

The Lattice of Foundational Constraint resisted at first, limitations pushing back against the power attempting to reshape them. But Noah didn’t relent. He poured more Observable Force into the gold hand, more Quintessence Infiniforce into the multicolored hand, overwhelming the resistance through sheer magnitude of what he provided.

|Engineering modification in progress. The Lattice of Foundational Constraint is experiencing forced expansion. Primary channels widening by factor of twelve. Secondary channels widening by factor of eight. Tertiary networks restructuring to accommodate increased flow capacity.|

|Nodes of concentrated energy are brightening. Junction points that previously flickered weakly are now blazing with intensity approaching what I observe in your own engineering. The artificial dimming is being overwritten.|

|Subject is experiencing significant sensation as her existence restructures around new parameters. The engineering that defined her for her entire existence is being rewritten in real time. Such alteration cannot occur without the subject being aware of what is happening to them.|
|Modification continuing. Seventy-three percent complete.|
Barbatos trembled beneath his hands.

Golden light began emanating from her skin, Observable Force flooding through channels that could suddenly accommodate its presence. Her dark hair started shifting, strands that had been purely black now showing rivers of gold running through them like veins of precious metal through stone. Her breathing came in gasps that released mist tinged with golden luminescence.
|Eighty-nine percent complete.|
|Ninety-four percent complete.|
|Modification complete.|
Noah slowly withdrew his hands.

The figure of Barbatos lay on the floating platform looking unfathomably beautiful! Her dark hair spread across the soft surface in waves now threaded with rivers of gold Observable Force, the coloring permanent rather than temporary. Her skin held luminescence that hadn’t been there before, subtle but undeniable illumination pressing outward from within.
And on her forehead, a barely discernible golden crack could be seen.

It looked like a line of fracture in porcelain, except instead of damage it suggested emergence. Something breaking through from beneath. Something that had been constrained finally finding expression in physical form!
Her gaze was dazed and heavy as she breathed out golden mist with each exhale.

She rose slowly to sit on the soft floating platform. Around her body, rivers of golden Observable Force surged in currents that responded to her presence, power that her existence could suddenly channel in ways that had been impossible moments before.
"Little Fish..."
Her voice emerged breathless.
"What did you just do?"
|Coomplete success has been observed in the modification of subject Barbatos’s Existential Engineering.|

|Her previous designation as a Bounded Lifeform is no longer accurate. The Lattice of Foundational Constraint has been replaced with what I shall term the Lattice of Nascent Emergence. Her channels have been widened to accommodate power flow at rates previously impossible for her classification. Her nodes have been brightened to store energy in concentrations that would have destroyed her former engineering. The artificial limitations that defined her existence have been removed.|
|She is now designated as a Nascent Hadean.|

|In practical terms, this means she is capable of beginning the refinement of her bones and organs toward full Hadean classification. The transformation you underwent through cycles of destruction and rebirth, she can now pursue. The ceiling that would have prevented such advancement no longer exists.|
|I should note several significant implications of this change.|

|First, a Nascent Hadean exists in territories that blur the line between THE First Scale and THE Second Scale. She has not established a Civilizational Anchor, but she now possesses potential that exceeds what establishing such an Anchor would normally provide. The Hadean Organs and Bones she can eventually form will be grander than the Proterozoic Organs and Bones that others form upon reaching THE Second Scale. She will, in essence, be able to achieve Hadean classification at THE First Scale, then carry that enhanced foundation into THE Second Scale if she chooses to establish her Anchor.|

|Second, the golden crack visible on her forehead represents the physical manifestation of her altered engineering. This marking will evolve as she progresses toward full Hadean transformation, eventually becoming something more elaborate as her existence fully integrates the changes you have implemented.|

|Third, her connection to you has deepened significantly through this process. The Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce you used to reshape her engineering now exists within her foundations as permanent presence. She is, in a very real sense, partially composed of your power now.|

|This was a successful first application of Existential Engineering.The methodology you employed intuitively appears to have been correct. Future applications may require adjustment based on subject variation, but the fundamental approach has proven viable.|
Noah read over all of this as Barbatos continued breathing heavily beside him, her existence acclimating to parameters that had just been completely rewritten.
He brought his vibrant right hand forward.

His palm cradled her head, fingers supporting the back of her skull while his hand covered all of her cheek. The touch was gentle despite the power still radiating from his transformed flesh. She looked at him with dark gold eyes that hadn’t been gold before, that shone with brilliance reflecting the Observable Force now flowing through her existence.
She cuddled against his hand to feel his warmth.
"What... have you done, Little Fish?"
She asked again as even her own existence couldn’t believe itself!
<Personal Reflections from THE Grimoire of Hadean Lexicon, Author: Noah Osmont, written during the span known as THE Reckoning of Imposed Order>

"I have often reflected upon the nature of pivotal moments, and I have come to understand that they rarely announce themselves with the fanfare one might expect. The grand turning points of existence, the instants where the trajectory of reality itself shifts toward weavings that will define eons yet to come, these moments tend to arrive quietly, dressed in the mundane clothing of ordinary action, revealing their true significance only when observed through the lens of considerable retrospection.

When I performed my first Nascent Hadean transformation upon Barbatos in the Early Veiled Shore, I believed I was conducting an experiment. A test of newly acquired capabilities. An exploration of what Existential Engineering might allow me to accomplish for those I cared about.I did not understand, could not have understood at that time, that I was striking the first blow against an architecture of existence that had governed Causes and Observable Existences since before many of us learned to perceive ourselves as existing.
I actually threw the first punch without realizing it.
That moment marked one of the last periods of relative peace I would experience.

I do have to confess, with the clarity that distance and time provides, that my ignorance was profound. I knew, of course, that the distinctions between Bounded and Gilded were permanent by design. But knowing that something is designed and understanding why it was designed, understanding who benefits from that design and what they will do to preserve it, these are different forms of knowledge entirely.
But even if I had known, I would have still done the same. Because who decided things had to be this way? What gave them the right? What ordained them to have any capability at all?

The engineering that constrains Bounded existence was not so much as artificially implemented...as much as it was simply nature. Just how existence was. There wasn’t something singular that could be said to be responsible. Existence simply was. Existence was...unfair. But it was structure an there were those who enjoyed such structure.

Those who sit atop structures of existentially imposed hierarchy rarely perceive their position as imposed. To them, the structure is natural and inevitable.The way things have always been and therefore the way things must always be.

The Bounded are Bounded because that is what they are. The Gilded are Gilded because that is what they are. And the Primeval, those ancient arbiters whose hands observed and directed Causes and studied and sought to manipulate the very engineering I was beginning to unravel, they exist beyond both because existence itself demands that someone must.
There was no good or evil. There was and is always what one believes.

When one alters the status quo, when one demonstrates that the limitations could be altered from below, when one proves that ceilings can be shattered and floors can be raised and the entire edifice of carefully maintained separation can be restructured through sufficient will and power, those who have benefited from that status quo tend to fight back.

They fight back because their position, their identity, their very understanding of their own significance depends upon the continued existence of those beneath them. A Gilded Lifeform is only Gilded in relation to the Bounded they surpass. Remove that relation, blur that distinction, demonstrate that the Bounded can become something that rivals or exceeds what the Gilded were engineered to be, and you do not merely threaten their power as you... threaten their meaning.
And to them, meaning is everything. For this, I pity Ubergulden Adelheid. I pity Ubergulden Markhus.

I did not know this when I placed my hands upon Barbatos and reshaped her engineering. I did not know that the peace I enjoyed in that moment, the relative calm of experimentation and discovery and the quiet joy of elevating someone I loved, would be one of the last moments of such peace I would experience before storms arrived that made Grimvault and his companions seem like gentle rain.
At that time, I truly did not know.

But I learned. Oh, how thoroughly I learned. And from all of it...endless seas of Observable and Unobservable Blood shall bloom. Existence will shudder, for it deserves to. All of Existence...deserves what is coming."

chapters.title: Chapter 5103: Parts To Play! I
paragraphs: Prima Indifferentia.

Grimvault tore through the boundaries between spaces with desperation he hadn’t felt in eons, his massive armored form trailing destruction through layers of existence that parted before his authority!
He had run far, farther than a Calymmian Tier Primordial Architect should ever need to run!
But THE fucking Infinite Light still burned around him.
He ran towards...home.
After an unknown period of time and a shift between spaces and a unique methodology...
WAP!
He appeared above an endlessly stretching white gold sea, the surface reflecting illumination that seemed to come from everywhere and nowhere simultaneously.
SPLASH!

His massive figure crashed into the white gold waters, that blackened silver armor that had fused with his flesh now wreathed in blue gold flames that refused to extinguish regardless of what he submerged them in.
The sea parted around him, waves spreading outward from his impact.
THE Infinite Light sought to unwind him.

He could feel it working against his existence even now! His form had stopped fluctuating only because he’d anchored himself again and again with his own Axiom, but the flames continued burning, continued trying to drag him backward through stages of development he had surpassed eons ago.
He had constantly enacted THE Silurian Light to counter it.

Pulse against Pulse. Fire against fire. But such deployment drained resources that even his ninety-four percent Proterozoic Bone saturation couldn’t replenish indefinitely. He could still cast it a few more times, could continue the struggle between his Pulse and Osmont’s...
But he didn’t want to continue risking it.

He had many different points of strength, and raw power was only one of them. Intelligence was another. Experience was another. And connection, alliance, the bonds forged across eons of service to something greater than himself, these too were strength that could be leveraged when individual capability proved insufficient!
He was connected to THE Deliverance.
A Civilization thrived from alliances and communication. No being, regardless of how powerful they became, could stand entirely alone against the vastness of existence.
He had served THE Deliverance faithfully. He had executed their directives. He had enforced their will. He had been their instrument when instruments were required!
Now he would call upon that service.

Grimvault rose from the white gold waters, his massive form dripping with liquid. The blue gold flames still wreathed his existence, still pressed against his anchored state with hunger that wouldn’t relent. He raised his arms toward the skies.
His voice emerged!
"I call upon bonds. I have never called for aid in all my spans of service..."
His pale fires blazed brighter beneath that wolf skull helm.
"I call now. Let THE Deliverance hear. Let THE Deliverance answer. Let THE Deliverance come forth and witness what has been wrought upon one who serves without question."
HUUM!
The seas churned quietly.

The white gold waters that had been merely trembling now began to rotate, currents forming that had nothing to do with natural flow and everything to do with power gathering in response to his invocation.
And it was unfathomably fast!
BOOM!
A dozen figures appeared before Grimvault.

Every single one radiated the terrifying aura of Primordial Architects at classifications that made his own Calymmian status seem modest. They floated above the churning waters in formations that suggested hierarchy. Some burned with fires of various colors. Others pulsed with authority that pressed against reality itself. All of them observed Grimvault with different gazes!
But the foremost figure drew his gaze entirely.
Platinum flames surrounded a humanoid titan whose form couldn’t be fully observed through the brilliance that shrouded him!
The fire didn’t merely burn around this entity. It seemed to emerge from him, to be part of what he was rather than something he wielded.
This was THE Deliverance.
Grimvault trembled before that presence.

His massive armored form, which had seemed so imposing when he confronted Osmont, now felt small and insignificant before the entity he had served across eons. He looked down with shame that pressed against his ancient existence, unable to meet the gaze of THE Deliverance or the gazes of others assembled here.
He had fled and had run from a being at THE First Scale. He had been driven to invoke aid he had never needed before!
The shame burned worse than THE Infinite Light still wreathing his form.
And yet...
"No need to feel shame for what happened, Grimvault."
THE Deliverance’s voice emerged deep enough to resonate through Grimvault’s foundations, through the white gold sea beneath them!
The words carried understanding rather than condemnation.
"Existence is filled with anomalies that even we cannot account for. The Infinity-bearer has proven himself to be precisely such an anomaly, and there is no disgrace in doing what you did."
The platinum flames flickered with something that might have been curiosity.
"Now, this is the Pulse you cannot erase? How does it feel?"
Grimvault looked up with gratitude that he couldn’t fully express. The understanding in THE Deliverance’s words, the lack of judgment despite his failure, it meant more than he could articulate!
He gathered himself, forcing his voice to emerge as calmly as he could manage given the circumstances.

"It feels like...regression, Sir. Like being pulled backward through every stage of development I have achieved across eons. The flames demand that I return to states I surpassed before most current powers existed. They seek to unwind my causality until I am reduced to something that precedes what I currently am."
He paused, the blue gold flames still dancing across his armored form.

"I have countered with THE Silurian Light repeatedly, but the Pulses seem evenly matched. Neither can overcome the other through direct confrontation. And I found myself unwilling to continue the expenditure when the outcome remained uncertain."
THE Deliverance nodded slowly, that massive form shifting within its shroud of platinum brilliance.
"THE Infinite Light, so he called it? A new Pulse never before seen...."
The platinum flames intensified.
"I understand. And I shall demonstrate how such a Pulse can be countered for future reference."
THE Deliverance raised three hands.
Grimvault blinked as he hadn’t realized the entity possessed more than two arms until that moment. Or...he just had the arms he needed to have at any time?
Three palms faced outward simultaneously, each one beginning the somatic components of different Pulses at the same time.
"THE Infinite Light operates on the principle of singular causality," THE Deliverance explained as his hands moved through gestures that overlapped without interfering with each other.

"It asserts a unique unknown Cause holds authority over those who lack its...brilliance, is it? But no single Cause holds authority over all others. When multiple Causes are invoked simultaneously, when their authorities overlap and interweave, the singular assertion of THE Infinite Light becomes diffused across contradictions it cannot resolve."
His first hand completed its gesture.
"THE Silurian Light provides the fire of primordial ignition."
His second hand completed its gesture.
"THE Cambrian Word provides the authority of rewritten consequence."
His third hand completed its gesture.
"And THE Ediacaran Silence provides the void where Causes cannot reach."
BOOM!
Three Pulses emerged simultaneously.
He...did not say any of the lengthy words required!

Flames of impossible colors, inscriptions of reality-rewriting authority, and absolute absence of sound and presence all manifested at once, weaving together in configurations that shouldn’t have been possible. The triple Pulse descended upon Grimvault’s burning form, not attacking him but enveloping him in contradictions that THE Infinite Light couldn’t navigate.
The blue gold flames flickered.

They pressed against the triple authority surrounding Grimvault, seeking purchase against existence that was being protected by three Causes asserting three different claims over reality. THE Infinite Light demanded regression, but THE Silurian Light declared that its fire preceded all regression. THE Cambrian Word rewrote the consequence of THE Infinite Light’s contact. And THE Ediacaran Silence created space where no Pulse could reach regardless of its origin.
The flames began to fade!

Blue gold brilliance that had burned for spans since Grimvault fled THE Wastes finally extinguished, dissolving into the white gold sea below as the triple Pulse unmade its hold on his existence. His massive armored form emerged from beneath the dying flames, restored to the state he had maintained before Osmont’s Pulse had touched him!
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 5104: Parts To Play! II
paragraphs: "This methodology requires the simultaneous casting of three Pulses," THE Deliverance continued as his hands lowered. "It is not something a common Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity can accomplish. The coordination alone exceeds what most at that classification can achieve, and the reserves required would deplete beings who lack sufficient Proterozoic Bone saturation."
The platinum flames settled into calmer configurations.

"But at these stages of existence, there are unique beings who can display tremendous power regardless of whether they are Rhyacian, Calymmian, or Ediacaran. Classification provides framework, not limitation. Remember this, Grimvault."
Grimvault bowed his massive form with gratitude.
"I will remember, Sir. Thank you."
He rose from the bow with expression that had shifted from shame to determination, those pale fires in his wolf skull helm burning with intensity restored.
"Sir, what shall be done to THE Infinity-bearer? To this Osmont?"

"He or his forces have now tortured or killed multiple of our brethren. Vahrkosis was unraveled by one of his allies. Sammarthiel remains trapped in paradoxical uncertainty. Beowulf was captured. And I was forced to flee from someone who should not have possessed the capability to threaten me."
His fists clenched at his sides.
"What response shall we provide?"
THE Deliverance was silent for a long moment.
The platinum flames surrounding his form flickered .
"There are... a great many complex things currently unfolding across Observable Existence. More than you know. More than most know."
The titan shifted within his flames.
"THE Infinity-bearer is an anomaly that requires handling, yes. His Infiniry, his progression, his immunity to THE Silurian Light...This Infinite Light...there is a lot to him."
A pause that seemed to stretch.
"But just moments ago, another matter arose that demands attention. THE Creature has returned to THE Wyld."
Grimvault’s pale fires flickered heavily.
"THE Wild Beast has come home," THE Deliverance continued as the platinum flames intensified.

"There is much to be done. The board has grown more complex than simple response to a single anomaly can address. THE Creature. THE Infinity-bearer. Too many variables shifting simultaneously for singular focus to serve our purposes."
THE Deliverance’s form seemed to grow larger within its shroud of platinum brilliance.

"Since THE Infinity-bearer seems to wish for adversity, we shall grant that wish. Let us hope he will bring us difficulty and adversity as well, for I have decided upon a response that serves multiple purposes."
His voice pressed against reality itself.
"I shall enact a... Civilizational War."
Grimvault’s eyes widened at those words.
A Civilizational War!
"This approach serves multiple functions,"THE Deliverance explained. "It keeps us occupied with legitimate purpose while ensuring the current stability of Observable Existence...among other things."
The platinum flames settled into configurations of finality.

"For I do not wish to do anything too grand when THE Creature and THE Infinity-bearer are the least of our problems. Existence is too vast, Grimvault. Far too vast. The anomalies we face now may be symptoms rather than causes, signals rather than sources. Signals that likely, those we have only whispered of...may make themselves more involved."
BOOM!
Those they whispered of!
They all knew what THE Deliverance was talking about!
THE Gilded!
Myths and stories, glory and wonder!
He turned, and the other eleven figures turned with him.
"Come, Grimvault. There is much to be done, and a great deal of us have our parts to play in what unfolds from this moment forward."
HUUM!
Blinding light erupted from THE Deliverance’s form, platinum brilliance expanding outward to envelop Grimvault and all others assembled above the white gold sea.
As they left, Grimvault gazed at his existence as he frowned as he felt like...his authority seemed to be tremendously depleted.
Maybe more than 25% of his total power still had not returned? Were the effects of THE Infinite Light so obscene?
He had such a thought as a moment later...
They were gone.
The white gold sea returned to calmness, its surface settling into stillness that betrayed nothing of what had just occurred above it, but...
A Civilizational War would soon be declared!
In THE Infiniverse.

THE Infiniverse herself floated within a sea of multicolored brilliance, boundless strings stretching from her form toward the Three Thousand Realms infinitely expanding in her depths. Each string pulsed with information flowing both directions, her awareness touching every sacred herb, every cultivating being, every fluctuation in the balance that comprised her nature.
Beside her, the illusory figure of Ruination floated with presence that seemed almost companionable.

THE Infiniverse turned her imperious gaze toward the strings stretching from her form. She had felt her Master’s Hadean transformation ripple through their connection. She had sensed the changes that declared him something unprecedented.
Now she contemplated what those changes meant for her.
"Master has led the way again."
Her voice pressed against the multicolored sea surrounding her.
"A Seed of Observable Existence becoming an Observable Existence is easy enough. Just like THE Second Scale from THE First Scale. But Master did not jump to THE Second Scale. He became...Hadean."
Her strings pulsed with intensity that made the Three Thousand Realms tremble.

"Naturally, I cannot become a measly Observable Existence like any other. The grander I become, the grander Master’s Infinite Cause becomes. So with his focus on Infinity and Observable Force, I shall flood everything within THE Infiniverse to transform its very backbone toward Hadean."
Her gaze fixed upon Ruination.
"Let us begin this process."
HUUM!
|I have initiated preliminary stages. The scope of what you propose exceeds anything previously attempted.|
Ruination’s form solidified slightly as she spoke.

|The Three Thousand Realms will undergo fundamental restructuring. Each realm’s foundational architecture will be reshaped toward Hadean parameters, meaning the laws governing them, the energy flows sustaining them, the very fabric of their reality will be elevated to classifications an Observable Existence cannot achieve.|
|The infinite expansion currently occurring will accelerate dramatically. Your realms may approach or exceed the scope of established Observable Existence|

|Beings cultivating within your depths will be affected. The Hadean nature of your restructured existence will press against their foundations, catalyzing advancement in those capable of withstanding it while endangering those who cannot.|
|Your connection to your Master will deepen unpredictably.|
A pause.

|If successful, you will become what I shall term aHadean Observable Existence. Not merely an Existence of Hadean classification, but an entire reality operating according to Hadean principles. The Three Thousand Realms will become Hadean Realms. You will blur the distinction between being and place in ways even your current nature does not achieve.|
THE Infiniverse absorbed this with eyes that blazed like stars being born.
"What comes will come regardless if we sit still or make bold moves. Begin the process."
HUUM!
Blue and gold painted everything as the two sisters tugged on their Master’s connection!

The multicolored sea erupted as Infinity surged through her depths while Observable Force flooded structures. The Three Thousand Realms trembled as power beyond their classification pressed against their foundations!
THE Infiniverse closed her eyes and felt herself changing.
It would take time. But... time was something she had in abundance.
