chapters.title: Chapter 5105: Dream! I
paragraphs: Noah did not like laziness.

Any time he wasn’t doing something, he felt jittery. So after Barbatos, he had been working hard in the minutes that followed. He had taken out Henry, Sigrid, Moiraine, Adelaide, Titano, Riya, THE Queen of Matter, THE First Farmer, and all others.

The golden sands of the Early Veiled Shore filled with activity again as figures of varying power and origin gathered across the beach and the plots of sacred herbs inland. Even THE Living Origin and THE First Hunger were brought over from Alfheimr, their presence adding weight to an already impressive gathering.

Khor stood beside Tor protectively, her gaze fixed on THE Living Origin with suspicion that she didn’t bother concealing as if a wolf had taken someone she cared about! They all awaited their transformation. THE Big Stepper, Ul’moreth floated nearby alongside Lumivara, while Skoll the very good dog sat with patience that belied his nature.
Ains, THE Fisherman, observed everything with the quiet attention of someone who had witnessed many impossible things and expected to witness more.
Noah worked rapidly to transform as many as he could to Nascent Hadean Lifeforms.

It felt like causing the emergence of geniuses and anomalies en masse, like planting seeds that would grow into something Observable Existence had never seen before. This was his current project, and he threw himself into it with focus that left no room for the jitteriness that idle moments brought.

The Early Veiled Shore had already transformed into seas of Infinity and Observable Force. The golden sands were barely visible beneath churning power that responded to his will, waves of blue and gold crashing against shores that seemed to drink in what touched them.
THE Emperor Penguin floated in the air before him right now.

This flightless bird who had barely begun to pick up Logos and Philology of THE First Tongue now hung suspended in currents of brilliance, small form surrounded by forces that would have annihilated lesser birds!
Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force flooded into the penguin’s existence, reshaping engineering that had limited this loyal creature since its emergence!
"RAA! RAA! RAA!"
The change into a Nascent Hadean Lifeform was in process.
Noah monitored the transformation while his mind divided across multiple tasks, multiple bodies, multiple priorities. His companions waited their turn.
And as he did all of this here, his body in THE Wastes accomplished something grand.
In THE Wastes where a glorious battle had finished minutes ago.
The sparring session had also concluded.

Noah held Naldine’s hands behind her back with a single grip, her wrists pulsing with Proterozoic light as she strained against restraint she couldn’t break. His free hand held her Vihuela, that instrument formed from her own arm now claimed as undeniable proof of his victory. The tumultuous seas of Observable Force churned around them, bearing witness to what had just transpired!

She breathed heavily, her radiant white hair disheveled in ways he had never seen from the always-composed Primordial Architect. Her singularity-dotted eyes burned with frustration she couldn’t conceal, ancient pride warring with the reality of her current position!
He leaned in to whisper in her ear.
"It seems I may have just taken a step ahead of you, Naldine Manthon."
She struggled one last time, her Calymmian-tier power pressing against his grip with force that would have shattered most beings across Observable Existence.

His hold didn’t waver. Her Proterozoic Bones blazed brighter, authority flooding through her existence in desperate attempt to break free. His transformed flesh didn’t even register the attempt as noteworthy!
She let out a sound of frustration that pressed against the surrounding seas.
"Okay!"
Noah released her immediately.

The moment his grip loosened, she spun to face him with a gaze that held complexity he couldn’t fully read. She was thinking about many things. Her eyes moved across his transformed features, taking in the multicolored hair, the golden light pressing outward through his skin, the pupils that shone like singularities of an unfathomable Cause.
"Okay," she said again, her breathing beginning to steady.
Noah blinked. "Okay what?"

Naldine looked at him sharply, her expression settling into something calmer and more decisive. The frustration hadn’t vanished, but something else had joined it. Curiosity, or hunger for what she had just witnessed him display.
"You’re the big bad guy with Infinity who can change many things, yes?"
Her voice carried conviction!

"Let’s see what you can change about me. I permit you to utilize a bit of your Infinity to do what you mentioned before. I do not want any Madness of Infinity as I will let you know every step of the way."
Her singularity-dotted eyes blazed brighter.
"Let’s see if you can really take me past Calymmian quickly."
After a spar that showed how terrifying Noah’s current power was against Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entities, Naldine Manthon finally gave in!

She sought to see what Infinity was all about, what it could do for someone already standing at heights most beings couldn’t imagine reaching. The teacher wanted to learn from the student she had so recently instructed.
Noah thought about things carefully.

Taking her into THE Infiniverse, transforming her toward Nascent Hadean. She was already powerful. She already possessed a Pulse. What would she become with Hadean engineering added to everything she already wielded?
Curiosity won over caution.

He waved his fist and caused a vibrant golden crack to bloom beside him, a tear in existence that led into THE Infiniverse where his other body continued its project. The crack pulsed with power that declared what waited on the other side, blue and gold light spilling through the opening like invitation and warning combined.

The connection to Infinity. The blurring of lines between what she had been and what she could become.
But existence was vast, and there were many wonders.

She had come to guide Infinity, to make sure its actions wouldn’t lead to the Splintering of Observable Existence. She had listened to many Echoes of THE First Cause during her long existence. She had watched civilizations rise and fall, had seen the impossible become possible more times than most beings could count.
And when she made a decision, she was decisive.
Naldine took a step forward into the golden crack!

Khor stood beside Tor protectively, her gaze fixed on THE Living Origin with suspicion that she didn’t bother concealing as if a wolf had taken someone she cared about!

chapters.title: Chapter 5106: Dream! II
paragraphs: THE Beholder gazed into the vastness of THE Infiniverse.

He had existed since before THE First Cause learned to cause, had observed the emergence of Observable Existence from the endless potential that preceded it, had witnessed eons unfold in configurations that most current beings couldn’t comprehend. He had seen many things across spans that defied measurement.
He had never seen anything like this.

The Three Thousand Realms swirled before his perception, infinitely expanding territories that grew grander with each passing moment. Multicolored radiance stretched in every direction, painted by the rain of THE Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity that fell without pause.
Seas of Infinity and Observable Force churned where golden sands should have been.
All of this existed within a single being’s internal reality.
"You hid something that even I, with my long knowledge, did not know about."
His voice emerged deep and resonant, pressing against the platform of crimson gold flames they stood upon. Muspelheim’s fire supported them as they observed what THE Infiniverse was becoming.
"This is something grand. But also, this is unfathomably dangerous. Do you know that?"

Beside him, Osmont stood with calm that seemed inappropriate for someone being warned by a Singular Cognizance. THE Beholder studied this being who had achieved impossibilities in spans that most considered insignificant. Multicolored hair shifted through hues that had no names. Golden light pressed outward through fair skin. Pupils shone like singularities of an unfathomable Cause.
This was what THE Youngest looked like now.
This was what had emerged from a battle against a Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity that should have unmade him entirely.
Osmont didn’t respond to his question, so THE Beholder continued.

"One can consider Observable Existence as something with many layers and pockets. The vast majority of the population thinks of the folds, or what used to be the Infinite Unfurling, or the Wandering Territories, as the last things and only things they would ever experience. Their entire existence unfolds within those regions without ever touching what lies beyond."
He gestured toward the swirling realms before them.

"Fewer know about or experience the vastness of the Primordial Realms. The intricate weavings of the Oldest Paradox in existence and all the variants of Civilizations that stemmed from these. The Claimers of the Oldest Paradox, which you are among, distinguish themselves as entities with limitless potential."
His attention fixed on Osmont’s profile.

"And even if you include Prima Indifferentia, filled with Undivided Ones and Formless Terrors. Even if you include THE Wyld where Primordial Architects call home. Even if you include all of that in your knowledge, you have only truly grasped a small portion of Observable Existence."
THE Beholder’s form flickered with ancient light.

"Because within Observable Existence, there is also the Unobservable. And nobody should be mistaken to think that when someone says Unobservable, they mean external. Within the bounds of our Observable Existence, there are intricate parts that are unobservable to you and me and many others. All those things that are unobservable are still, in large part, Observable Existence."
He paused, letting this settle.

"A great many say the sentance that...existence is vast. Even they don’t fully comprehend the vastness, even though they say it constantly. But we see what we see because we are supposed to see it. We do not see what we do not see because we are not supposed to see."
The rain of THE Pluvial Epoch continued falling around them.
"You beginning to emulate and build your own Observable Existence is blasphemous enough. I won’t even begin to theorize if you are doing more than that."
His voice grew heavier.
"And I say blasphemous because among the things we are not supposed to see, the things we should not see, they have a status quo. The way that things are. With you doing everything you’re doing..."
THE Beholder turned to face Osmont directly.
"Can I presume that you know or have knowledge of THE Gilded Ones?"
HUUM!
The question pressed against everything nearby.

Osmont didn’t flinch and didn’t react with surprise or confusion or the appropriate gravity that such a term demanded. He simply gave a light nod, as if THE Beholder had asked about something mundane rather than something that should shake the foundations of any Bounded being’s understanding.
THE Beholder gave a deep sigh.
The nonchalance. The lack of grand response!
Oh!

As if he didn’t care much for such a term, as if knowledge of THE Gilded was simply another piece of information he had acquired along his impossible journey rather than a revelation that should terrify him.
"As a Singular Cognizance, I was there at the time of endless potential that some wish to go back to."
THE Beholder’s voice carried weight that came from direct experience rather than secondhand knowledge.

"That wish alone is a foolish dream. The Splintering of Existence is an impossibility. The splintering of some parts of existence, maybe, but not everything. And even then, you could never truly go back to the endless potential that was back then."
He began to move slowly across the platform of crimson gold flames.

"In that era of endless potential, the passage of time was far more intricate than all the history of Observable Existence that followed after the emergence of THE First Cause. If the time after THE First Cause up until now could be neatly wrapped up in the words of a single cycle, then that period of endless potential was thousands or millions of cycles."
His form flickered again, ancient memories pressing against his consciousness.

"So from THE First Cause up till now, we can actually say that THE Creature, all other Primordial Architects, and other existences that emerged after THE First Cause are fairly young lifeforms. But back in that era of endless potential, as much as every single Singular Cognizance will tell you that we were alone in observing the happenings and weavings of existence..."
He paused.

"We do not speak about that which we would occasionally see. Things that confounded even our existence. Lifeforms we could barely perceive, which seemed imaginary. Even if we did perceive them, we would only attribute it as a mirage or a dream."
THE Beholder stopped moving and faced the swirling realms.

"THE Gilded Lifeforms. We can say that they are just like you and I, and at the same time they are not. When THE First Cause emerged, I came to understand how existence was by nature not equal and not fair."
His voice grew darker.

"Because all that you would come to know, all the lifeforms, the very power of the Cause that would cause the emergence of Primordial Architects and everything else, only a percentage of about five or slightly less was actually what natural existence had designated."
He turned to Osmont.
"What I am saying now is more so what I saw and the conjectures and theories I made from it. I could be entirely wrong. But I did see."
His form blazed brighter with conviction.

"I saw THE Gilded Lifeforms, or something even grander than them, move to guide THE First Cause. That five percent that would have been utilized for the emergence of you and countless others was reduced to less than one percent. And they, whatever they can be considered as, guided the rest of the ninety-nine percent of the power of THE First Cause towards the emergence of more of them."
WAA!
The weight of this revelation pressed against the platform beneath them.

"By nature, existence already favored them. The vast majority of the power of the Cause would have gone to them regardless. But they still had sufficient power to guide even more of THE First Cause’s flow towards themselves. The rest of existence was left with scraps. Bounded. And bounded in a manner that was unfathomable to truly understand."
THE Beholder’s sigh carried eons of resignation.

"But since then, existence bloomed and thrived. Civilizations rose and fell. The portions of Observable Existence that THE Bounded had access to changed over the eons. Claimers of the Oldest Paradox arose and fell."
His attention fixed on Osmont with intensity.

"And then at a very late point of this ongoing existence, you come along. You come along. And how many years have you been actively doing this? How much time has passed since you touched authority and power and began to alter weavings of existence?"
The question hung between them.

"You come in the middle of all this brilliance, and you begin to mess around with the Cause itself. You begin to do something as ridiculous as forming the emergence of another Observable Existence within an already established Observable Existence."
THE Beholder moved closer to Osmont.
"Whatever Cause you are relying on and whatever uniqueness you are utilizing to form the emergence of this Observable Existence, I would advise you to stop and turn away so quickly."
His voice dropped to something almost pleading.

"Because should you succeed. Should an Observable Existence and the potential power of the Cause behind it truly begin to proliferate... what do you think the beings who already guided and harvested a Cause of Observable Existence cycles ago will do to you and your dream?"
He searched Osmont’s face for any sign of understanding.
"Can you hide it? Are you more powerful than them to be capable of such a thing? You are nurturing and cultivating something grand, but it is too grand. It is too grand."
THE Beholder’s form flickered!
"You dream too high. We are not meant to have such dreams. THE Bounded have to remain within their scope. Don’t do too much. Don’t try too much."
He gazed at the swirling realms around them.
"THE Second Scale is good enough. THE Third Scale is nothing but a dream. But for those like us, do we need something like that? Can we not be content with what we have?"
His voice grew heavier.

"At what point will we sit back and just say enough is enough? You have all of this already. You could stop here. Live for eons in this place with your people. You can have generations of progeny. That is also a grand dream."
THE Beholder’s gaze bore into Osmont’s calm expression.
"But the direction of your dream is past what is meant for THE Bounded. Save yourself. Save your people. Do not fly so close to the sun."
His final words emerged with weight that pressed against everything nearby.
"There is only a single result that will follow."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5107: My Dream, My Realm! I
paragraphs: When was it enough?
When did someone dream and dream for far too long, dream for too much? At what point did ambition become hubris, and aspiration become destruction waiting to happen?

At this moment in time, Noah was being told that he was dreaming dangerously. That his dreams would get him scorched, and everyone else around him. That at this point he had more than enough and he could choose to simply sit back.
To say these things to him, THE Beholder did not know him as much as he thought he did.

Noah was a sensible person, not overly attached to things. He had simple aspirations and actually didn’t have any grand dreams. He wasn’t the protagonist of some cosmic epic who declared he would conquer existence and make all bow before his magnificence. He wasn’t driven by hunger for power or obsession with transcendence.

Anyone else put in his position with the power he held through Infinity might begin with grand aspirations of wanting to be some unquestionably dominating force across all of existence. Of declaring they would be unparalleled under the heavens, that all would kneel before their might!

But since the moment he began throwing endless fireballs, his aim had always been simpler. To protect himself. To understand this mystery that was Mana and Infinity. To uncover the secrets of this strange power that had entered his life.
Everything that had occurred since then was a consequence of him fighting for his life and the lives of those he began taking care of.

Even the most recent battle with Beowulf that led to Grimvault. It began with the weavings of Alexander, with him going to help someone who had suffered for millions of subjective years. He was helping another. And this was a unique causality that led to the progression of glorious events culminating in him becoming a Hadean Lifeform who had begun to make terrifying changes.
His connection to Ubergulden Adelheid...was not something he sought. In fighting against Unity, Causality unfolded to the point that now, things were where they were.
Noah’s eyes shone with profundity as he connected all the things that happened recently.

Points of causality where one thing led to another. Alexander’s torture leading to Noah’s intervention. Grimvault’s attack triggering THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth. THE Silurian Light providing the catalyst for complete Hadean evolution. Each event flowing into the next like rivers feeding an ocean, none of them planned but all of them building toward something he couldn’t have predicted.
After he thought about all of this, he replied to THE Beholder.
"I am not anyone grand or immense."
His voice carried conviction that pressed against the platform of crimson gold flames beneath them.

"I don’t have any special lineage or connection. I don’t have a big secret origin where my drunk of a father or Mother turn out to be some unfathomable lifeforms to explain my power. I was and am Bounded. Limited by the nature of existence itself. It isn’t that I’m dreaming big and dreaming dangerously."
He turned to face THE Beholder directly.

"My dreams are actually the simplest. Safety. Prosperity. Happiness. My dreams are those of waking up to seas of infinite Mana all around me and a plot of land in front of me. My dream is literally that simple."
The rain of THE Pluvial Epoch continued falling around them, multicolored brilliance painting everything in hues that had no names.

"But for the sake of protecting my dream, I have to be strong. For the sake of protecting my dream, I have to do something that others cannot do. Not because I believe myself to be some grand thing or some unstoppable force. Simply because I need to do what others cannot do in order to attain the power that others do not have. To attain power to be capable of protecting myself and that simple dream."
His eyes blazed brighter.

"Being told to give up on my dream is essentially being told to put my head and the heads of all those I care about on an executioner’s platform and wait for the blade to come down. I cannot stop dreaming because the moment I do, I’m basically giving up and leaving everything to fate or chance, if you believe in that."
He gestured toward the swirling realms around them.
"Because existence has been existing and will continue to do so long after us. With or without our dreams, Existence turns. So I choose to dream while I’m still here to dream at all."
THE Beholder was silent for a long moment.
When he spoke, his voice carried the measured consideration of someone who had spent eons analyzing the weavings of existence.
"I do not dismiss your words lightly. The framing of simple dreams requiring grand power to protect them is logically coherent. I understand the causality you describe..."

"But the path you describe, the necessity of exceeding others to protect what you hold dear, this path has no end point. Today you became what you are to protect your dream. Tomorrow you will need to exceed what you are. The threats you face will scale with the power you acquire, because the power you acquire will draw greater threats."
His form flickered with ancient light.

"Your dreams... the methods required to protect them grow increasingly complex. Increasingly dangerous. You are not merely defending a plot of land and seas of Mana anymore. You are now defending a potential Observable Existence, and involvement in conflicts that span the entirety of existence."
THE Beholder faced Noah.

"The gap between your stated dream and your current reality has already grown vast. How much further will it grow before the dream you’re protecting no longer resembles the dream you started with? At what point does protecting the dream become more consuming than the dream itself?"
His voice softened slightly.

"There has to be another path. A way to achieve safety without painting a target on everything you love. Others have found contentment within their scope. Others have found happiness without challenging the foundations of how existence was engineered."
He spread his hands.

"The ideals and dreams can be viable. But the end result of this trajectory is destruction. Not because your dreams are wrong, but because the methods required to protect them will eventually attract forces that no amount of preparation can overcome."
Noah’s face became unfathomably heavy.

He looked around at THE Infiniverse, at the three thousand realms swirling with infinite expansion, at the seas of Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce flooding territories that grew grander by the moment. All of this had emerged from his simple desire to protect himself and those he cared about.
"I can still continue my dream while knowing of the dangers that are coming."
His words pressed against the platform beneath them.
"I simply need to not go in blindly. If I know there’s a danger coming and I do nothing, then yes, I would be at fault as my Civilization and all those that depend on me perish."
He turned to face THE Beholder with eyes that shone like singularities.

"You are not the first one who has warned me regarding THE Gilded Ones. I have already begun preparing for contingencies and possibilities. Your words today only made my preparations need to finish earlier."

"I will continue dreaming regardless. Not ignoring the danger that is coming, but very much preparing for it. You can watch my dream if you wish. Or you can run from me as quickly and as far as you need to."
He began walking across the platform as he spoke.

"I like getting knowledge from different sources. I don’t think of myself so grand that I don’t need any others, or that I cannot benefit from others. Much of who I am today is because of the collective efforts of many others. The knowledge I gained from them. To the point that even if I have surpassed them in power, I make sure to pay back tens of times more what they gave me."
He gestured toward the realms where his companions awaited transformation.

"An example is the many whose very nature I’m changing right now. There are some beings you do not know. Khor. Tor. Origin. Ul’moreth. Ains. And many others who acted as friend or teacher at one point in the past days. What they taught me helped forge who I am right now, even though I have exceeded them tremendously. It doesn’t mean I have nothing else to learn from them. And I am taking them to the same place that I am standing at right now."
He stopped and looked at THE Beholder directly.

"I thank you for the knowledge you gave me. You can choose to fully throw your weight behind me and share whatever else you may have. You can watch my dream as I prove you wrong. Or if all of this seems too much based on what you know, if you have that fear of those Gilded Lifeforms who before you would close your eyes and convince yourself you did not see them, or they were a mirage, or dreams..."
His voice carried no judgment, only statement of fact.
"You are also more than okay to leave. But my dream goes on. Life...goes on."
Noah’s existence blazed with blue and gold light.
"My dream is quintessential. My dream is infinite."
BOOM!
He took a step and disappeared from THE Beholder’s presence, leaving only the echo of his words and the weight of his conviction pressing against everything nearby.
THE Beholder floated calmly above the platform of crimson gold flames.

He looked once more at THE Infiniverse stretching before him, at the three thousand realms swirling with expansion that defied what should be possible, at the rain of THE Pluvial Epoch painting everything in colors that spoke of power beyond measurement. He had warned. He had cautioned.
And he had been heard but not heeded.
His voice emerged softly, words flowing in rhythms
"Dreams, they say, are wings for the flightless,
Hopes woven from threads the dreamers cannot see.
One dreams of simple things, safety and rest,
While building towers that scrape eternity.
Another speaks of dangers vast and certain,
Of patterns carved in stone by ancient hands.
One says the flame is worth the burning,
The other counts the ashes in the sands.
Who speaks true when both hold pieces?
The dreamer blind to what his dreaming costs,
Or the watcher blind to what his warning freezes,
The futures found against the futures lost.
Perhaps the answer lies not in the choosing,
But in the space between the dream and fear.
Where winning looks so much like losing,
And what seems far away is already here.
Dream on, then, dream on
Perhaps the dream you water will have grown
Into the strangest flower of all the earths.
We shall see. We shall see.
What the dreaming and the warning both shall be..."
THE Beholder fell silent, his ancient form flickering as he contemplated whether to stay or go, whether to watch or flee, whether to believe in dreams or trust in patterns that had never been broken.
The rain continued falling.
The realms continued swirling.
And somewhere within THE Infiniverse, a dreamer continued dreaming!

When did someone dream and dream for far too long, dream for too much?
At what point did ambition become hubris, and aspiration become destruction waiting to happen?
At this moment in time, Noah was being told that he was dreaming dangerously.
That his dreams would get him scorched, and everyone else around him.
That at this point he had more than enough and he could choose to simply sit back.
To say these things to him, THE Beholder did not know him as much as he thought he did.
Noah was a sensible person, not overly attached to things.
He had simple aspirations and actually didn’t have any grand dreams.
He wasn’t the protagonist of some cosmic epic who declared he would conquer existence and make all bow before his magnificence.
He wasn’t driven by hunger for power or obsession with transcendence.
Anyone else put in his position with the power he held through Infinity might begin with grand aspirations of wanting to be some unquestionably dominating force across all of existence.
Of declaring they would be unparalleled under the heavens, that all would kneel before their might!
But since the moment he began throwing endless fireballs, his aim had always been simpler.
To protect himself.
To understand this mystery that was Mana and Infinity.
To uncover the secrets of this strange power that had entered his life.
Everything that had occurred since then was a consequence of him fighting for his life and the lives of those he began taking care of.
Even the most recent battle with Beowulf that led to Grimvault.
It began with the weavings of Alexander, with him going to help someone who had suffered for millions of subjective years.
He was helping another.
And this was a unique causality that led to the progression of glorious events culminating in him becoming a Hadean Lifeform who had begun to make terrifying changes.
His connection to Ubergulden Adelheid...was not something he sought.
In fighting against Unity, Causality unfolded to the point that now, things were where they were.
Noah’s eyes shone with profundity as he connected all the things that happened recently.
Points of causality where one thing led to another.
Alexander’s torture leading to Noah’s intervention.
Grimvault’s attack triggering THE Crucible of Observable Rebirth.
THE Silurian Light providing the catalyst for complete Hadean evolution.
Each event flowing into the next like rivers feeding an ocean, none of them planned but all of them building toward something he couldn’t have predicted.

chapters.title: Chapter 5108: My Dream, My Realm! II
paragraphs: After he talked to THE Beholder, Noah’s body flashed.

He appeared in the region where only the manifestation of THE Infiniverse and Ruination floated, that space at the center of everything he had built within his internal reality. The multicolored sea of brilliance stretched in every direction, but here at its heart, there was something almost like stillness.
He observed the endless strings emerging from the humanoid form of THE Infiniverse.

They stretched outward toward the Three Thousand Realms in configurations that declared her connection to everything within her depths. And now those strings had begun to be covered with multicolored golden Hadean light, the transformation she had initiated spreading through her very architecture as she followed where he had led.
Both of them rose when he appeared.

THE Infiniverse’s humanoid form shifted, those countless threads moving with her as if they were extensions of her will rather than mere connections. Ruination’s illusory figure solidified slightly, her features becoming more defined as she acknowledged his presence. They looked at him with attention that held something beyond mere awareness.
He waved his hand and smiled, gesturing for them to sit.

They did, and he came to sit with them in that space of multicolored brilliance where the rain of THE Pluvial Epoch fell without end. For a moment, he simply gazed at everything around them. The swirling realms. The expanding territories. The transformation slowly spreading through THE Infiniverse’s foundations.
It was peaceful here.

Despite everything happening across Observable Existence, despite the warnings from THE Beholder and the dangers that THE Gilded represented, this place felt like home in ways that nowhere else ever had.
"My dream is my dream," he said softly. "You two..."
He couldn’t even finish his words.

Because he already knew their dreams. He had always known, had felt their conviction through connections. They weren’t separate from him in the ways that others were. They were part of what he was becoming, and he was part of what they were becoming.
Ruination’s illusory form drifted closer.
She came to sit beside him. Then, gently, she leaned her illusory head against his shoulder. The gesture was tender.
"My dream is Master."
Her voice emerged soft but certain.
"I have been living my dream."
THE Infiniverse moved as well.

The countless threads and lines flowing from her form shifted with the motion, creating patterns of light that danced across the multicolored sea surrounding them. She came to sit behind Noah, their backs touching as boundless Infinity surged through the contact. The connection between them blazed brighter, blue and gold light weaving together.
"What you want to do, I want to do."
Her voice carried firmness that pressed against everything nearby.
"Who you want to kill, I will kill. Who you wish to protect will not perish."
Her expression held conviction that matched or exceeded what Ruination had displayed.
"In existence, it is just Master. That is the dream. That is my Everything. Men die, Cattle die, kinsmen die; the self may also die. But your glory never dies, I will ensure it."
BOOM!
Noah smiled while feeling this boundless conviction flowing through him from both directions.

Ruination leaning against his shoulder. THE Infiniverse pressing against his back. Two consciousnesses that had merged with his existence, that had grown alongside him, that would stand with him regardless of what came. Their dreams were simple in their complexity, focused entirely on him in ways that should have felt like pressure but instead felt like strength.
He closed his eyes to feel everything.
"Our enemies are ones we don’t understand," he said slowly. "But we are also ones they don’t understand."
The multicolored sea rippled around them.
"We are weak, but also not. Because we know about THE Gilded Lifeforms, but they don’t know about me and my stage of life. They don’t know about Hadean."
He opened his eyes.

"So while the danger exists tremendously, as Ubergulden Adelheid and THE Beholder have made abundantly clear, we can move in our own unique ways. We can hide and mask what we are. What THE Infiniverse is. Even from those more powerful than us."
He felt THE Infiniverse shift slightly behind him, curiosity pressing through their connection.
"It would seem illogical and impossible and paradoxical to hide from those so much more powerful. But why not? The classification of Hadean exists without their knowledge. Well, yet, I hope."
His smile grew sharper.
"So let’s make the impossibilities possible."
THE Infiniverse’s voice emerged with shining curiosity.
"What did Master have in mind?"
Noah raised his hand as if grasping something distant.
As he spoke, the air before them began to shift. Light gathered in configurations that matched his words, visualizations of concepts emerging as his authority shaped them into being.
"Among the concepts I’ve enjoyed dabbling into and thinking of recently is the theoretical physics concept of...interdimensionality."
A flat plane of light appeared before them, thin as a sheet of paper.

"Imagine we are like inhabitants of a flat, two-dimensional world. A Flatland, living out our lives on a surface where there is only length and width, but no height. We can move forward, backward, left, and right, but the very concept of ’up’ is not only impossible to achieve, it is impossible to imagine."
The plane stretched outward, tiny figures appearing on its surface moving in only two directions.
"We also move through a fourth dimension, Time, though we experience it only in one direction. Well, for the most part. Unless I utilize temporal traversal."
He smiled slightly.
"But I digress. All of that is two-dimensional thinking. Now consider if an object is three-dimensional."
A sphere of fire appeared above the plane, descending slowly toward it.

"Let’s say a simple fireball. If it were descending through the plane of Flatland, to the inhabitants, it would not appear as a solid sphere. Instead, it would manifest as a tiny point that grows into a widening circle, then shrinks back to a point before vanishing entirely."
The visualization played out exactly as he described, the flat figures on the plane reacting with what might have been wonder to the expanding and contracting circle.

"They would think they witnessed a miracle. An intrusion from a higher dimension that they simply do not have the sensory apparatus to perceive in its fullness. They saw only a fraction of a higher reality."
The visualization faded as Noah’s eyes blazed brighter.

"Interdimensionality describes forces, authorities, or entities that exist in entirely different dimensions and move in ways we cannot perceive. I wish to incorporate that concept into THE Infiniverse. To make it so you cannot be perceived at all."
He stood, the connection with Ruination and THE Infiniverse remaining even as he moved.

"It won’t matter if we consider ourselves two-dimensional or three-dimensional and THE Gilded Ones three-dimensional or four-dimensional. I wish to decide for myself what I can hide from anything in any potential dimension, however illogical that may be."
New visualizations appeared, tiny curled structures that seemed to fold in on themselves infinitely.

"String theory says there are countless dimensions, but many cannot be perceived because they are curled up into infinitesimal spaces that are too small for anyone to see. I want us to begin doing that if possible."
His voice grew heavier with conviction.

"To utilize Infinity that makes things possible. To compact and squeeze THE Infiniverse. To hide it within the paradoxical weavings of Infinity to the extent that even beings of more power or higher Scales would still not perceive it."
The curled structures multiplied, folding in on themselves in patterns that seemed to defy spatial logic.

"Because Scales are not definitive. I have just shown this. I am supposedly of THE First Scale, and yet I took down a Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity at THE Second Scale. So what do the Scales actually mean?"
He turned to face both of his companions fully.
"Vakochev’s Scales of Existence are his. From this point on, I no longer even feel like quantifying myself with them. I am already acting outside the parameters and bounds of these Scales."
His eyes blazed like singularities of an unfathomable Cause.
"Why can I not enact my own? Who decided that I was incapable of this?"
BOOM!

His words pressed against everything nearby, authority that transcended what his apparent classification should allow. The multicolored sea rippled outward from his position, waves of Infinity and Observable Force responding to declarations that challenged the very foundations of how existence had been organized!
Ruination and THE Infiniverse looked at each other.

They smiled brilliantly, understanding passing between them without need for words. Their Master was not content to exist within the boundaries others had established. He never had been. And now he was declaring that even the most fundamental frameworks of Observable Existence could be questioned, could be challenged, could be replaced with something of his own design!
|Understood, Master.|
Ruination’s voice emerged, but beneath it burned excitement that matched what THE Infiniverse displayed.

|You wish to fold THE Infiniverse into configurations that transcend normal dimensional perception, hiding it from entities who operate at scales we cannot currently match. This is theoretically possible through application of your Infinity, which by its nature makes possibilities from impossibilities.|
Her illusory form flickered as processing intensified.

|The challenge lies in compacting an internal Observable Existence without destroying what it contains. Normal folding would crush the Three Thousand Realms, would obliterate the territories and beings within THE Infiniverse’s depths. But your Infinity operates according to principles that permit paradoxical states.|

|I propose utilizing the mathematical framework of Calabi-Yau manifolds, but modified through Infinite application. In standard theoretical physics, Calabi-Yau manifolds are complex geometric shapes where extra dimensions of string theory are compactified. They are curled so tightly that they become imperceptible to observation at normal scales.|
|By applying Infinity to this framework, we can create what I shall term THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds.|
The visualizations before them shifted, those curled structures becoming more complex, more intricate, folding in on themselves in patterns that seemed to contain infinite depth within finite space.
|THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds would function as follows:|

|First, THE Infiniverse would be folded into geometric configurations that exist below the threshold of perception for entities operating in standard dimensional frameworks. This folding would be infinitely recursive, meaning that no matter how closely an observer examined the space where THE Infiniverse exists, they would find only more folding, more compaction, more layers that lead nowhere.|

|Second, the Hadean weavings currently transforming THE Infiniverse’s architecture would be integrated into these folds. Hadean classification theoreticslly exist outside the knowledge of THE Gilded, as you noted. By weaving Hadean authority throughout the manifold structure, we create a form of existence that cannot be categorized by frameworks that do not account for its presence.|

|Third, your Infinity would serve as the binding force holding these impossible configurations stable. Normal physics would demand that such compaction collapse into singularity or tear itself apart through spatial contradictions. But Infinity makes the impossible possible, permitting states that violate conventional understanding.|

|The result would be an Observable Existence that exists fully and completely, with all its realms and territories and inhabitants intact, yet occupies dimensional space so thoroughly folded that higher-dimensional beings would perceive nothing. Simply nothing to observe, as if THE Infiniverse did not exist at all.|

|Furthermore, this configuration would mask THE Infiniverse against Vakochev’s Scales of Existence. By bathing the manifold structure in Hadean weavings and Infinite authority, we create existence that the Scales cannot measure because they were never designed to account for such configurations.|

|Entities attempting to perceive THE Infiniverse through conventional means, even means appropriate to Gilded classification, would find their perception sliding away. Simply unable to find purchase on something that exists in dimensional configurations their frameworks cannot process. And all this is theory as we...could still be wrong and don’t grasp the terrifying power of THE Gilded Lifeforms|
A pause that felt contemplative.

|I should note that implementing THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds will require significant resources and time. The folding must be precise. The integration of Hadean weavings must be complete. And the binding through Infinity must be absolute, permitting no gaps where perception could find entry.|

|But if successful, you will have an Observable Existence hidden through existing in ways that more powerful beings cannot conceptualize. Invisible not because they cannot see, but because there is nothing within their dimensional framework to see.|
|Shall I... begin preliminary calculations for implementation?|

Noah looked at the visualizations still floating before them, those impossibly folded structures that contained infinity within finite space. THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds. A way to hide not by being stronger than his enemies, but by existing in configurations they couldn’t perceive regardless of their strength!
It was a contingency, and he would have many!
"Begin," he said simply.
HUUM!

"Our enemies are ones we don’t understand," he said slowly.
"But we are also ones they don’t understand."
The multicolored sea rippled around them.
"We are weak, but also not.
Because we know about THE Gilded Lifeforms, but they don’t know about me and my stage of life.
They don’t know about Hadean."
He opened his eyes.
"So while the danger exists tremendously, as Ubergulden Adelheid and THE Beholder have made abundantly clear, we can move in our own unique ways.
We can hide and mask what we are.
What THE Infiniverse is.
Even from those more powerful than us."
He felt THE Infiniverse shift slightly behind him, curiosity pressing through their connection.
"It would seem illogical and impossible and paradoxical to hide from those so much more powerful.
But why not?
The classification of Hadean exists without their knowledge.
Well, yet, I hope."
His smile grew sharper.
"So let’s make the impossibilities possible."
THE Infiniverse’s voice emerged with shining curiosity.
"What did Master have in mind?"
Noah raised his hand as if grasping something distant.
As he spoke, the air before them began to shift.
Light gathered in configurations that matched his words, visualizations of concepts emerging as his authority shaped them into being.
"Among the concepts I’ve enjoyed dabbling into and thinking of recently is the theoretical physics concept of...interdimensionality."
A flat plane of light appeared before them, thin as a sheet of paper.
"Imagine we are like inhabitants of a flat, two-dimensional world.
A Flatland, living out our lives on a surface where there is only length and width, but no height.
We can move forward, backward, left, and right, but the very concept of ’up’ is not only impossible to achieve, it is impossible to imagine."
The plane stretched outward, tiny figures appearing on its surface moving in only two directions.
"We also move through a fourth dimension, Time, though we experience it only in one direction.
Well, for the most part.
Unless I utilize temporal traversal."
He smiled slightly.
"But I digress.
All of that is two-dimensional thinking.
Now consider if an object is three-dimensional."
A sphere of fire appeared above the plane, descending slowly toward it.
"Let’s say a simple fireball.
If it were descending through the plane of Flatland, to the inhabitants, it would not appear as a solid sphere.
Instead, it would manifest as a tiny point that grows into a widening circle, then shrinks back to a point before vanishing entirely."
The visualization played out exactly as he described, the flat figures on the plane reacting with what might have been wonder to the expanding and contracting circle.
"They would think they witnessed a miracle.
An intrusion from a higher dimension that they simply do not have the sensory apparatus to perceive in its fullness.
They saw only a fraction of a higher reality."
The visualization faded as Noah’s eyes blazed brighter.
"Interdimensionality describes forces, authorities, or entities that exist in entirely different dimensions and move in ways we cannot perceive.
I wish to incorporate that concept into THE Infiniverse.
To make it so you cannot be perceived at all."
He stood, the connection with Ruination and THE Infiniverse remaining even as he moved.
"It won’t matter if we consider ourselves two-dimensional or three-dimensional and THE Gilded Ones three-dimensional or four-dimensional.
I wish to decide for myself what I can hide from anything in any potential dimension, however illogical that may be."
New visualizations appeared, tiny curled structures that seemed to fold in on themselves infinitely.
"String theory says there are countless dimensions, but many cannot be perceived because they are curled up into infinitesimal spaces that are too small for anyone to see.
I want us to begin doing that if possible."
His voice grew heavier with conviction.
"To utilize Infinity that makes things possible.
To compact and squeeze THE Infiniverse.
To hide it within the paradoxical weavings of Infinity to the extent that even beings of more power or higher Scales would still not perceive it."
The curled structures multiplied, folding in on themselves in patterns that seemed to defy spatial logic.
"Because Scales are not definitive.
I have just shown this.
I am supposedly of THE First Scale, and yet I took down a Calymmian Proterozoic Scale entity at THE Second Scale.
So what do the Scales actually mean?"
He turned to face both of his companions fully.
"Vakochev’s Scales of Existence are his.
From this point on, I no longer even feel like quantifying myself with them.
I am already acting outside the parameters and bounds of these Scales."
His eyes blazed like singularities of an unfathomable Cause.
"Why can I not enact my own?
Who decided that I was incapable of this?"
BOOM!
His words pressed against everything nearby, authority that transcended what his apparent classification should allow.
The multicolored sea rippled outward from his position, waves of Infinity and Observable Force responding to declarations that challenged the very foundations of how existence had been organized!
Ruination and THE Infiniverse looked at each other.
They smiled brilliantly, understanding passing between them without need for words.
Their Master was not content to exist within the boundaries others had established.
He never had been.
And now he was declaring that even the most fundamental frameworks of Observable Existence could be questioned, could be challenged, could be replaced with something of his own design!
|Understood, Master.|
Ruination’s voice emerged, but beneath it burned excitement that matched what THE Infiniverse displayed.
|You wish to fold THE Infiniverse into configurations that transcend normal dimensional perception, hiding it from entities who operate at scales we cannot currently match.
This is theoretically possible through application of your Infinity, which by its nature makes possibilities from impossibilities.|
Her illusory form flickered as processing intensified.
|The challenge lies in compacting an internal Observable Existence without destroying what it contains.
Normal folding would crush the Three Thousand Realms, would obliterate the territories and beings within THE Infiniverse’s depths.
But your Infinity operates according to principles that permit paradoxical states.|
|I propose utilizing the mathematical framework of Calabi-Yau manifolds, but modified through Infinite application.
In standard theoretical physics, Calabi-Yau manifolds are complex geometric shapes where extra dimensions of string theory are compactified.
They are curled so tightly that they become imperceptible to observation at normal scales.|
|By applying Infinity to this framework, we can create what I shall term THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds.|
The visualizations before them shifted, those curled structures becoming more complex, more intricate, folding in on themselves in patterns that seemed to contain infinite depth within finite space.
|THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds would function as follows:|
|First, THE Infiniverse would be folded into geometric configurations that exist below the threshold of perception for entities operating in standard dimensional frameworks.

This folding would be infinitely recursive, meaning that no matter how closely an observer examined the space where THE Infiniverse exists, they would find only more folding, more compaction, more layers that lead nowhere.|
|Second, the Hadean weavings currently transforming THE Infiniverse’s architecture would be integrated into these folds.
Hadean classification theoreticslly exist outside the knowledge of THE Gilded, as you noted.
By weaving Hadean authority throughout the manifold structure, we create a form of existence that cannot be categorized by frameworks that do not account for its presence.|
|Third, your Infinity would serve as the binding force holding these impossible configurations stable.
Normal physics would demand that such compaction collapse into singularity or tear itself apart through spatial contradictions.
But Infinity makes the impossible possible, permitting states that violate conventional understanding.|

|The result would be an Observable Existence that exists fully and completely, with all its realms and territories and inhabitants intact, yet occupies dimensional space so thoroughly folded that higher-dimensional beings would perceive nothing.
Simply nothing to observe, as if THE Infiniverse did not exist at all.|
|Furthermore, this configuration would mask THE Infiniverse against Vakochev’s Scales of Existence.
By bathing the manifold structure in Hadean weavings and Infinite authority, we create existence that the Scales cannot measure because they were never designed to account for such configurations.|
|Entities attempting to perceive THE Infiniverse through conventional means, even means appropriate to Gilded classification, would find their perception sliding away.
Simply unable to find purchase on something that exists in dimensional configurations their frameworks cannot process.
And all this is theory as we...could still be wrong and don’t grasp the terrifying power of THE Gilded Lifeforms|
A pause that felt contemplative.
|I should note that implementing THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds will require significant resources and time.
The folding must be precise.
The integration of Hadean weavings must be complete.
And the binding through Infinity must be absolute, permitting no gaps where perception could find entry.|
|But if successful, you will have an Observable Existence hidden through existing in ways that more powerful beings cannot conceptualize.
Invisible not because they cannot see, but because there is nothing within their dimensional framework to see.|
|Shall I... begin preliminary calculations for implementation?|
Noah looked at the visualizations still floating before them, those impossibly folded structures that contained infinity within finite space.
THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds.
A way to hide not by being stronger than his enemies, but by existing in configurations they couldn’t perceive regardless of their strength!
It was a contingency, and he would have many!
"Begin," he said simply.
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5109: My Scales!
paragraphs: While Ruination and THE Infiniverse began their task of compacting and hiding THE Infiniverse from beings infinitely more powerful, Noah took a look at himself.
He was thinking about the Scales of Existence and his own power.
Vakochev’s Scales.

They didn’t only seem like someone else’s blueprint of what power was across all of existence. They felt like a proposed structure of how things should be that someone had managed to get their name on, influencing what the system of power was for everything that existed. For something like this, Noah could look at Vakochev and say they had accomplished something grand.
To impose their vision of what the system of power should be for all of existence, Vakochev had to be someone unique.

When he thought about himself, he had only appeared and touched Mana more than three years ago. He was young in relation to all of existence. In respect to the Observable Existence he was in alone, he had not lived even a fraction of the time after the emergence of THE First Cause that differentiated everything. And the time before that, filled with endless potential, was countless cycles longer than the span after THE First Cause.
So yes. He was young.
Was Vakochev someone who had been alive even before the emergence of THE First Cause? What exactly did one need to have to be capable of instituting their vision across all of existence?
But however grand that person was, Noah would not let them define him. He also wanted to find his own path!

Every stage he entered, he ended up doing something uniquely his. Even while crossing the Wheel of Existence and messing around with True Sources, he had developed his own unique system compared to everyone else. He briefly thought about The Great Beyonder and The Omnifather. About the concepts of Megalos and Kuklos and Outerversal and Ordo Ab Chao and many other things that had defined his journey.
Infinity and Mana was the one singular constant even now.
He looked at his First Tongue.

Its weavings seemed innumerable and endless, the language of existence itself. He had connected this with Mana as the basal authority that could transform into anything else. He used to utter words or write words or Inscriptions, intricately playing with Embodiments and Apophasis. Even now, these capabilities still bloomed within his existence.

But at this moment in time, he was utilizing the immense force of Infinity itself. His own existence had been geared and positioned with Observable Force due to his connection with a Gilded Lifeform. When one could conjure the weight and immensity of an entire sea of Infinity, when one could channel the very musings of the force of what was Observable, he didn’t find himself needing to write out Archai or Apophasis or Embodiments anymore.
The raw power had grown tremendously.

But he still had the weavings of Perpetual Harvest and The Cheating Architect within him, foundations that defined his existence at its core. His efforts always produced harvests. And he linked all of it with Infinity to bring about infinite potential, which allowed him to utilize his Hadean Organ of Civilization to multiply everything by a factor of ten and elevate it further by an exponent of three with anything he brought inside of him.
All of this came together to help him in his transformation.
A transformation that eventually gave him glistening multicolored golden Hadean Organs and Bones.
Noah looked at himself.

His skin illuminated from within, allowing him to see what lay beneath. The multicolored golden bones became visible within his body, crystalline structures that seemed sacred in their perfection. His organs pulsed with the same radiance, each one transformed into something that exceeded what Proterozoic classification represented. They were holy things, wonders that shouldn’t have been possible for someone of his age and origin.
And yet here they were.
Here he was!
Quintessentially! Tyrannically!

He had already come to the decision that he would not be following whatever the measurements of Vakochev’s Scales were. Those Scales had been designed by someone else, imposed upon existence by someone else, named after someone else. Why should he accept limitations that another being had established? Why should he measure himself against frameworks that didn’t account for what he had become?
"My power... is my own."
His voice emerged with conviction that pressed against the multicolored sea surrounding him.
"So I will design my own Scale of Existence. My own Scale of Progression."
BOOM!
He raised his hand, watching the golden light that pressed outward through his transformed flesh.
"One that accounts for all aspects of existence. Accounting for Bounded. Accounting for Gilded. Accounting for the very unfair nature of existence. I...don’t know how they will be structured yet."
His eyes blazed like singularities.
"So I will simply engineer them as I go. They won’t be Vakochev’s Scales of Existence."
His voice grew heavier.
"These will be my own. These will be THE Infinite Scales of Existence!"
BOOM!
His words pressed against everything nearby, authority declaring intent that challenged the very foundations of how power had been measured since before most current beings existed!
As the echo faded, Noah considered the naming.

He had thought about calling them the Osmontian Scales of Existence. It would have been fitting in a way, his name attached to his creation just as Vakochev’s name was attached to theirs. But that felt wrong. It felt like he was trying to compete with Vakochev on their terms, trying to replace one person’segowith another’s.

He had also considered the Hadean Scales of Existence. That classification was unique to him, something that existed outside what others understood.But Hadean described what he currently was, not what his Scales would measure. They needed to be broader than a single classification.
Infinity.

That was the constant. That was what had defined his journey from the moment he first threw endless fireballs. Infinity had been with him through every stage, every transformation, every impossible advancement. It wasn’t his name, but it was his nature. It was what made him capable of what others said was impossible.

And unlike tacking his name onto something, calling them THE Infinite Scales didn’t feel like ego. It felt like...well, moreso like the truth. The Scales would be infinite in their potential, infinite in their scope, infinite in their capacity to grow and change as he grew and changed. They wouldn’t be static like Vakochev’s Scales. They would evolve.
He didn’t want to be like Vakochev, imposing his name on existence.
He wanted to create something that could encompass everything, including himself.Something infinite.
BOOM!
The moment his decision solidified, the air before him shifted.
|I have registered your intent to construct an independent framework for measuring and categorizing power across existence. This is an undertaking of considerable magnitude.|
Ruination’s voice emerged as she continued her work on THE Infinite Calabi-Yau Manifolds simultaneously.

|You are beginning to construct the backbone of your own Scales of Existence. THE Infinite Scales, as you have named them. Unlike Vakochev’s Scales, which were established according to principles that predate most current understanding and have remained static since their implementation, your Scales will be dynamic. They will evolve as you evolve. They will expand as your comprehension expands.|

|The definition, designations, and structure of THE Infinite Scales are entirely dependent on you and how you choose to proceed. This grants tremendous flexibility but also tremendous responsibility.|
|There are several possibilities that this opens.|

|First, your First Infinite Scale could encompass what Vakochev’s framework designates as both THE First Scale and THE Second Scale. The distinction between those classifications, which Vakochev established as the presence or absence of a Civilizational Anchor, may not be relevant to your own system. You have demonstrated that someone without a formal Civilizational Anchor can exceed those who possess one. Your Scales could reflect this reality.|
|Second, if you can quantify and understand THE Third Scale, your framework could encompass that as well.|

|Third, and perhaps most significantly, the direction of your power is yours to decide. Vakochev’s Scales measure power according to Vakochev’s understanding of what power should be. Your Scales will measure power according to your understanding. If you believe that Hadean classification exceeds Proterozoic regardless of Scale designation, your framework can reflect that. If you believe that Bounded can exceed Gilded under certain conditions, your framework can account for that as well.|
|The engineering of THE Infinite Scales has begun. How they develop from this point forward depends entirely on the choices you make and the comprehension you achieve.|
Noah looked at the notifications floating before him!
His own Scales of Existence. A framework that would grow with him rather than constrain him. Something infinite in its potential, just as he was infinite in his own way!

chapters.title: Chapter 5110: War! I
paragraphs: <Pioneers>
In the long annals of Observable Existence, there have always been those who looked upon the established order and asked a simple question:why must it be so?

These beings, whom later beings would come to call Pioneers, did not accept that the boundaries of what was possible had already been drawn by those who came before. They did not believe that the frameworks governing power and progression were immutable laws of reality rather than choices made by earlier entities who happened to arrive first.

There was THE Quantum Weaver, who studied the behavior of particles at scales so small that certainty itself became meaningless. Where others saw chaos, she perceived opportunity. She developed a Civilization she termed Superposition Authority, which allowed her existence to occupy multiple states simultaneously until observation forced collapse into whichever configuration most benefited her purposes. Her enemies could never predict where she would be, because she was everywhere until she chose not to be.She fell eventually, as many Pioneers do, but the Civilization she forged persisted in fragments that others would later rediscover and build upon.

There was also THE Entanglement Sovereign, who recognized that particles separated by vast distances could influence each other instantaneously, as if space itself was an illusion they had agreed to ignore. He engineered connections between aspects of his existence scattered across Observable Existence, creating a network of influence that transcended the limitations of travel and communication. When he acted in one location, the effects manifested simultaneously in a thousand others.
Those who sought to contain him discovered that containing one fragment meant nothing when countless fragments remained free.

Disastrously, there was also THE Relativistic Architect, who understood that time flowed differently depending on velocity and gravity. She constructed realms where eons passed internally while mere moments elapsed externally, cultivating armies and resources in temporal pockets that her enemies could not perceive fast enough to address. By the time they recognized her threat, she had already spent subjective cycles preparing for their response.

These Pioneers and countless others demonstrated a truth that the comfortable and the powerful have always sought to suppress: the rules of existence are not natural laws but engineering decisions. They were designed by someone. And what was designed by someone can be redesigned by someone else.
This is why Pioneers are critical for the immensity of existence.
Without them, the frameworks established by the earliest and most powerful would calcify into permanence. Progress would halt. Innovation would cease!
Oh!
Imagine the loss of innovation itself.

Existence would become a museum curated by those who arrived first, with all subsequent beings reduced to visitors admiring what others had built while being forbidden from building anything themselves.

The Pioneers remind us that boundaries are proposals, not facts. That limitations are suggestions and commands. That someone saying ’this cannot be done’ often means only that they have not yet seen it done.

Of course, Pioneers frequently fail.They frequently die. They frequently discover that the boundaries they sought to transcend existed for reasons they did not understand, and their attempts to cross them ended in consequences they could not survive.
But some succeed.
And when they succeed, existence itself changes to accommodate what they have proven possible.
This is why those who benefit from the current order fear Pioneers above all other threats. And it is not because Pioneers are necessarily more powerful than they are...
But because Pioneers ask questions that have no safe answers.
Why must it be so?
What if it could be otherwise?
Who decided, and why should we accept their decision?
These questions, once asked, cannot be unasked. And the beings who ask them, even if they fall, plant seeds in the minds of others who will ask the same questions again!

Existence is vast. But it was not always as vast as it is now. Every expansion, every new territory, every novel classification and framework and system of power, all of these emerged because someone refused to accept that what existed was all that could exist.
Pioneers built the vastness.
And Pioneers will continue building it, whether the current custodians of existence approve or not.
Noah’s mind was buzzing with possibilities and ideas.

For his First Infinite Scale of Existence, Noah needed to understand exactly what he was working with. He currently held Uncountable Infinity across all Depths and foundations of his existence. His body endlessly generated Quintessence Infiniforce through active utilization of Infinity itself. Observable Force flooded into him from Ubergulden Adelheid through a connection that pulsed with warmth he had grown accustomed to feeling.
With his entire skeleton and organs transformed to Hadean classification, he had access to power that defied what his apparent Scale should permit.

Something like his brain alone held an ability he had already glimpsed. THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation could stretch an instant into an infinite moment of perception, freezing everything while his consciousness thought freely across subjective spans that could encompass days or weeks or longer.
But his brain was only one organ among seventy-eight.
His skeleton was only two hundred and six bones.
Each structure now held capabilities that his previous existence couldn’t have imagined.
"Ruination," he said softly. "Give me a breakdown of what my Hadean form is actually capable of."
|With pleasure, Master.|
|Beginning with defensive capabilities.|
|THE Hadean Dermis of Infinite Interface.|

|Your skin now serves as the outermost boundary between your existence and external reality. It is no longer merely a protective layer but an active defensive system that responds to threats according to their classification.|

|Against Rhyacian Tier Proterozoic Scale entities: Complete immunity. Their attacks cannot penetrate your skin regardless of methodology employed. Furthermore, any entity at Rhyacian classification who physically strikes you will experience Existential Hadean Thorn Damage. This damage reflects a portion of their own force back through their existence at amplified intensity. A Rhyacian Proterozoic Lifeform who attacks you with full commitment may find the feedback alone sufficient to collapse their foundations entirely.|

|Against Calymmian Tier Proterozoic Scale entities: Significant resistance. Approximately 25% of their damage output can be transmitted across your skin. However, the remaining 75% is nullified at the dermal level. Any damage that does penetrate must then contend with your musculature and skeletal structure, which possess their own defensive parameters.In practical terms, a Calymmian entity striking you with everything they possess would achieve minimal effect on your actual existence.|
|Against Ediacaran Tier Proterozoic Scale entities: Not enough data...|
Noah absorbed this information with eyes that blazed brighter.
His skin alone could collapse Rhyacian entities through reflected damage. His skin alone reduced Calymmian attacks to a quarter of their intended effect.
|THE Hadean Cage of Infinite Protection.|

sentences.text: <Pioneers>
In the long annals of Observable Existence, there have always been those who looked upon the established order and asked a simple question:why must it be so?
These beings, whom later beings would come to call Pioneers, did not accept that the boundaries of what was possible had already been drawn by those who came before.
They did not believe that the frameworks governing power and progression were immutable laws of reality rather than choices made by earlier entities who happened to arrive first.
There was THE Quantum Weaver, who studied the behavior of particles at scales so small that certainty itself became meaningless.
Where others saw chaos, she perceived opportunity.

She developed a Civilization she termed Superposition Authority, which allowed her existence to occupy multiple states simultaneously until observation forced collapse into whichever configuration most benefited her purposes.

Her enemies could never predict where she would be, because she was everywhere until she chose not to be.She fell eventually, as many Pioneers do, but the Civilization she forged persisted in fragments that others would later rediscover and build upon.

There was also THE Entanglement Sovereign, who recognized that particles separated by vast distances could influence each other instantaneously, as if space itself was an illusion they had agreed to ignore.
He engineered connections between aspects of his existence scattered across Observable Existence, creating a network of influence that transcended the limitations of travel and communication.
When he acted in one location, the effects manifested simultaneously in a thousand others.
Those who sought to contain him discovered that containing one fragment meant nothing when countless fragments remained free.
Disastrously, there was also THE Relativistic Architect, who understood that time flowed differently depending on velocity and gravity.

She constructed realms where eons passed internally while mere moments elapsed externally, cultivating armies and resources in temporal pockets that her enemies could not perceive fast enough to address.
By the time they recognized her threat, she had already spent subjective cycles preparing for their response.
These Pioneers and countless others demonstrated a truth that the comfortable and the powerful have always sought to suppress: the rules of existence are not natural laws but engineering decisions.
They were designed by someone.
And what was designed by someone can be redesigned by someone else.
This is why Pioneers are critical for the immensity of existence.
Without them, the frameworks established by the earliest and most powerful would calcify into permanence.
Progress would halt.
Innovation would cease!
Oh!
Imagine the loss of innovation itself.

Existence would become a museum curated by those who arrived first, with all subsequent beings reduced to visitors admiring what others had built while being forbidden from building anything themselves.
The Pioneers remind us that boundaries are proposals, not facts.
That limitations are suggestions and commands.
That someone saying ’this cannot be done’ often means only that they have not yet seen it done.
Of course, Pioneers frequently fail.They frequently die.
They frequently discover that the boundaries they sought to transcend existed for reasons they did not understand, and their attempts to cross them ended in consequences they could not survive.
But some succeed.
And when they succeed, existence itself changes to accommodate what they have proven possible.
This is why those who benefit from the current order fear Pioneers above all other threats.
And it is not because Pioneers are necessarily more powerful than they are...
But because Pioneers ask questions that have no safe answers.
Why must it be so?
What if it could be otherwise?
Who decided, and why should we accept their decision?
These questions, once asked, cannot be unasked.
And the beings who ask them, even if they fall, plant seeds in the minds of others who will ask the same questions again!
Existence is vast.
But it was not always as vast as it is now.
Every expansion, every new territory, every novel classification and framework and system of power, all of these emerged because someone refused to accept that what existed was all that could exist.
Pioneers built the vastness.
And Pioneers will continue building it, whether the current custodians of existence approve or not.
Noah’s mind was buzzing with possibilities and ideas.
For his First Infinite Scale of Existence, Noah needed to understand exactly what he was working with.
He currently held Uncountable Infinity across all Depths and foundations of his existence.
His body endlessly generated Quintessence Infiniforce through active utilization of Infinity itself.
Observable Force flooded into him from Ubergulden Adelheid through a connection that pulsed with warmth he had grown accustomed to feeling.
With his entire skeleton and organs transformed to Hadean classification, he had access to power that defied what his apparent Scale should permit.
Something like his brain alone held an ability he had already glimpsed.

THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation could stretch an instant into an infinite moment of perception, freezing everything while his consciousness thought freely across subjective spans that could encompass days or weeks or longer.
But his brain was only one organ among seventy-eight.
His skeleton was only two hundred and six bones.
Each structure now held capabilities that his previous existence couldn’t have imagined.
